title: Junior HR & Admin Executive
description:
We're Hiring: Junior HR \& Admin Executive – Be the Backbone of a Fast\-Growing AI Startup 
 



  





 This isn't a "sit in a corner and file documents" HR role. You'll be the person who keeps the office running, keeps candidates and clients responded to, and keeps the founders free to build. If you like variety, people, and getting things done, this is your role.
 



  





**Role Details** 




 Position: Junior HR \& Admin Executive
 



 Location: Nagarabhavi, Bangalore (On\-site)
 



 Type: Full\-time
 



 Experience: 0 – 2 years
 



 Joining: Immediate joiners strongly preferred
 



  





**About Us** 




 AI Nexus Innovations Hub is a Bengaluru\-based deep\-tech startup building AI\-native platforms for healthcare (MedOrbit.ai – hospital management system) and education (Edvation.ai – school operating system). We're early\-stage, growing our team and our customer base, and we need someone who can hold the operational side together.
 



  





  What You'll Do
 



  





**1️⃣ HR \& Recruitment** 




 → Post job openings on LinkedIn, Naukri and other portals; screen resumes and schedule interviews
 



 → Coordinate with candidates – calls, emails, interview follow\-ups, offer letters and joining formalities
 



 → Handle onboarding and induction for new joiners – documents, accounts, laptop, introductions
 



 → Maintain employee records, attendance and leave tracking
 



 → Support payroll inputs, PF/ESI documentation and HR policies with the founders
 



 → Organise team engagement activities, birthdays and celebrations
 



  





**2️⃣ Office Administration** 




 → Manage day\-to\-day office operations – supplies,, vendors, courier, utilities
 



 → Coordinate with vendors for laptops, internet, facility and other purchases; track invoices and bills
 



 → Maintain office assets, documents and basic bookkeeping records
 



 → Arrange travel, meetings, visitor handling and event logistics for the team
 



  





**3️⃣ Client Communication \& Follow\-up Support** 




 → Send introduction emails, brochures, proposals and meeting confirmations to hospitals, schools and business partners
 



 → Follow up with clients by email, phone and WhatsApp on demos, documents and pending responses
 



 → Maintain a client tracker with every email, call and next step logged
 



 → Coordinate demo scheduling between clients and the founding team
 



  





  





**What You Bring** 




 Must\-Have:
 



 → Any graduate (BBA / B.Com / BA / MBA\-HR preferred, but not mandatory)
 



 → Excellent spoken and written English, plus Kannada and/or Hindi (essential for calls with hospitals and schools)
 



 → Confident, polite phone manner – comfortable making calls and following up without hesitation
 



 → Strong organisation skills – you keep trackers updated, never miss a follow\-up, and can juggle multiple tasks
 



 → Good with MS Office / Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs, Gmail, Calendar)
 



 → Professional email writing skills
 



 → A "no task is too small" attitude – you take ownership of whatever keeps the company moving
 



 → Trustworthy with confidential employee and client information
 



  





**Nice\-to\-Have (Bonus Points!):** 




 → Internship or 6\+ months experience in HR, admin, front office, telecalling or customer support
 



 → Familiarity with job portals (Naukri, LinkedIn Recruiter) or HRMS tools (Keka, Zoho People, greytHR)
 



 → Basic knowledge of PF, ESI, and Indian labour compliance
 



 → Experience using a CRM or lead\-tracking tool
 



 → Exposure to startups, healthcare or education organisations
 



  





**Why Join AI Nexus?** 




 ✅ Wear many hats – HR, admin, client coordination – and build a broad skill set fast
 



 ✅ Work directly with the founders; your work is visible every day
 



 ✅ Grow into an HR Manager / Operations Lead role as the company scales
 



 ✅ Laptop provided, friendly and flexible startup culture
 



 ✅ Be part of a team building AI products for hospitals and schools across India
 



  





 📩 Ready to Keep a Startup Running?
 



 Send your resume to: raju@thenexushub.ai
 



 Website: https://www.ainexushub.ai/

* Don't just manage paperwork. Run the show. Grow with us.

title: Senior Human Resources Business Partner
description:
**About Client:** 
 We are on a mission to move a billion dreams by building the most trusted, effi cient, and seamless logistics platform in India. We started in 2014 with a simple vision — to transform intra\-city logistics through technology.
 



  





 We solve real\-world problems — from empowering micro\-entrepreneurs and truck/2W owners, to optimizing last\-mile delivery for SMEs and enterprises. Every challenge we take on has real consequences and real impact.
 



  





 With a sharp focus on user obsession, ownership, and collaboration, were building a workplace where people thrive when they take bold bets, move fast, and build with empathy.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a dynamic and strategic People Business Partner to join our HO team. This role will directly partner with Business Leaders to shape people strategy, drive organizational effectiveness, and enable business outcomes. This position requires a high degree of strategic thinking, problem\-solving, and the ability to infl uence senior stakeholders in fast\-paced, high growth environments.
 



  





 This is an individual contributor role with high visibility and impact across multiple business threads. The ideal candidate thrives in startup ecosystems, brings strong business acumen, and can independently drive complex people initiatives end\-to\-end.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Strategic Partnering: Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, aligning people strategy with business goals across multiple threads.
* Influence \& Leadership: Proactively infl uence senior stakeholders by providing data\-driven insights, thought partnership, and actionable recommendations.
* Org Design \& Effectiveness: Partner with leaders on org design, talent planning, and scaling structures for effi ciency and growth.
* Talent \& Capability: Identify capability gaps, shape talent development initiatives, and drive manager effectiveness programs.
* Culture \& Engagement: Strengthen the high\-performance culture by driving initiatives around employee experience, engagement, and values alignment.
* Change Management: Lead critical change programs and help leaders navigate organizational transitions with minimal friction.
* Data\-Driven Insights: Use data and analytics to diagnose people issues, forecast risks, and infl uence leadership action.
* Execution Excellence: Balance strategy with execution by independently driving high\-priority HR initiatives end\-to\-end.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* 5–8 years of progressive HR experience, with at least 2–3 years in high\-growth startup or scale\-up environments.
* Strong track record of strategic HR partnering at the business leadership level.
* Demonstrated ability to infl uence senior leaders through insights and credibility.
* Comfortable working as an individual contributor with high accountability and ownership.
* Excellent stakeholder management, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
* Strong bias for action, comfort with ambiguity, and ability to thrive in fast\-paced environments.



  





**Why Join Us?** 



* Opportunity to shape the people agenda for business\-critical threads directly at HO.
* High visibility with leadership and business heads.
* A culture that values ownership, innovation, and impact.
* The chance to play a strategic HR role in an organization at a pivotal stage of growth.

title: HR Business Partner
description:
Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies, and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King, sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging what's possible for a sustainable world.
   

  

 Learn about our benefits designed for you to Thrive at work and at home.
   

  

 We boldly go.
   

  

****Where Is The Work:****
 Monday to Thursday, work onsite with your colleagues. Fridays, choose your work location, balancing what your work requires.
   

  

 At Trane Technologies™ and through our businesses including  Trane® and Thermo King®, we create innovative climate solutions for buildings, homes, and transportation that challenge what’s possible for a sustainable world. We're a team that dares to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities. We believe in a better future when we uplift others and enable our people to thrive at work and at home. We boldly go.
   

  

****What’s In It For You:****
 Trane is excited to announce an incredible opportunity for a talented professional to join our team as a
 **Manager – Human Resources** 
 for India Engineering and Technology Centers. In this pivotal role, you will play the role of HR business partner supporting senior leaders and will collaborate closely with the talent acquisition team, HR solutions team, T\&OC team and total rewards team to meet your deliverables.
   

  

****Thrive At Work And At Home:****
* Inclusive Wellbeing Program, with resources to support your and your family’s physical, social, emotional, and financial well\-being.
* Comprehensive learning and development solutions, designed to support our people in connecting and growing, including Higher education/Certification reimbursement.
* Sense of belonging \& community through our Employee Resource Groups that foster our culture of inclusion.
* Volunteerism: 8 hours of paid time off per calendar year to volunteer with non\-profit charitable organizations.
* The Trane Technologies Helping Hands Fund to support employees facing financial challenges due to unforeseen personal hardship.


****Where Is The Work:****
 This position is eligible for a hybrid work schedule (4 or more days onsite per week) based out of Bangalore.
   

  

****Strategic Partnership:****
**What you will do:**
* Collaborate with senior leadership to understand the business strategy and develop HR strategies that support the organization’s goals.
* Provide strategic input and leadership on decisions affecting the organization, including workforce planning, organizational design, and talent management.


****Talent Management:****
* Lead talent management initiatives including talent reviews, succession planning, leadership development, and performance management.
* Partner for key talent development \& growth


****Employee Relations:****
* Act as a trusted advisor to people leaders and employees on a wide range of HR matters, including conflict resolution, performance improvement, and employee engagement.
* Manage employee relations in a fair and consistent manner.


****Change Management:****
* Drive and support organizational change initiatives, ensuring effective communication and stakeholder engagement.
* Develop and implement change management strategies to support business transformation and culture enhancement.


****HR Analytics:****
* Utilize HR metrics and analytics to enable data driven decision\-making and measure the effectiveness of HR initiatives.
* Provide insights and recommendations based on data to drive continuous improvement and business impact.


****Learning And Development:****
* Partner with the Learning and Development SPOC to identify training needs and enable execution of programs that enhance employee skills and capabilities.
* Promote a culture of continuous learning and professional development.


****Total Rewards:****
* Collaborate with senior leaders to facilitate informed compensation decisions, analyses, interventions, and insights.
* Provide guidance on compensation strategies and manage the annual compensation review process.
* Provide insights on benefits to total rewards leader based on stakeholder interactions


****HR Projects \& Org Initiatives:****
* Lead \& partner on HR projects at both the country and team level.
* Partner with the Org initiative leads to seamlessly execute the initiatives, counsel and provide support for success.


****Culture Steward:****
* Serve as a People \& Culture advisor, coach, and partner with people leaders to ensure their success.
* Provide support to people leaders on their respective employee engagement initiatives.


****What You Will Bring:****
* 12\+ years of HR business partnering experience, preferably within Global Capability Centers (GCCs) and IT/ITES organizations.
* Postgraduate degree in Business Management with specialization in Human Resources.
* Effective interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills, with a proactive and self\-driven approach.
* Demonstrated experience in coaching and partnering with leaders.
* Effective problem\-solving capabilities with a collaborative and team\-oriented working style.
* Innovative mindset with the ability to enhance processes and develop effective solutions to business challenges.
* Proven experience in HR analytics and data\-driven decision\-making.
* Good understanding of leveraging AI in HR, supported by demonstrated practical experience.
* Hands\-on experience working with Workday HCM.
* Proven ability to plan and collaborate effectively across functions and with key stakeholders to successfully deliver HR initiatives and projects.
* Solid understanding of current talent trends, market practices, and evolving people strategies.
* Good learning agility with the ability to quickly adapt to new concepts, changes, and ways of working.


****Career Break:****
 We have a Relaunch Program for professionals looking to restart their careers after a break. If you come with a career break of at least 12 months and match the work experience requirements mentioned, you are welcome to apply.
   

  

****Equal Employment Opportunity:****
 We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. We are an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, pregnancy, age, marital status, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any legally protected status.

title: Senior HR Partner, Amazon International Stores and G&A
description:
**Description**
 At Amazon, HR Partners are known for their deep knowledge of HR policies, processes and tools. They act as front\-line talent consultants to the business, supporting managers in creating a positive employee experience and offering the best HR advice on people matters. They offer credible and compelling advice to business managers on how to manage their team. HR Partners collaborate with HR Business Partners and HR Centers of Excellence like Benefits, Compensation and Employee Relations who support our employees across the region. Thanks to their front\-line visibility across businesses, HR Partners are in a position to spot trends, identify emerging needs and address them at scale, in collaboration with the appropriate business and HR stakeholders
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 The Senior HR Partner (Sr. HRP) collaborates with business managers to support them with sensitive and often complex employee issues including disciplinary, performance improvement and grievance processes. The Sr. HRP acts as an influential partner in helping managers with talent and performance management processes, people development, HR policies and implementation of organizational changes. Sr. HRPs drive scalable process improvements and standardization at a country, regional as well as global level. The Sr. HRP is expected to work with global HRPs and COE functions to drive WW HRP goals and initiatives.
   

  

* Performance Management: Work with people managers through performance management cases, including process steps, coaching and guidance to deliver fair and high\-bar performance management experience.
* Employee Relations: Support relevant ER processes, including disciplinary \& performance improvement programs. Consult managers on people matters that require in depth knowledge of policies, procedures and local legislation. Manage ER cases, in coordination with the Employee Relations and Legal Teams.
* People Development: Enable the success of new \& experienced managers by leveraging and improving existing training content and collaborating with the central Talent Development teams to anticipate and address emerging needs. Support people managers with career conversations, Development Plans/Career Growth Plans and other development initiatives.
* HR Generalist: Act as stewards of the employee experience and Amazon’s culture. Act as subject matter expert for people tools, processes, programs or projects. Analyze data and observations across the organization, highlighting trends and recommending/driving solutions, as appropriate.
* Change Management: Support managers and HR leaders to drive improvements in employee experience and change initiatives.


 This role is performed through an innovative customer relationship management tool, which enables this team to be uniquely positioned to identify trending issues and themes through data and inform consequent decisions and initiatives.
   

  

 Job is open for Bangalore and Hyderabad locations
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Master's degree, or Bachelor's degree
* 5\+ years of HR generalist, management, or business partner role experience
* Knowledge of HR, HR management, organizational development concepts
* Experience in problem solving and delivering results


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in a fast paced, dynamic organization
* Experience managing time efficiently, meeting personal goals, and working effectively with internal, partner, and customer teams
* Experience delivering complex, data\-driven recommendations to senior leaders
* Experience communicating with a wide range of stakeholders, including colleagues and leadership, or experience managing teams


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Snr Director of HR (Position located in Bangalore, India)
description:
KnowBe4 empowers the modern workforce to make smarter security decisions every day. Trusted by more than 70,000 organizations worldwide, KnowBe4 is the pioneer of digital workforce security, securing both AI agents and humans. The KnowBe4 Platform provides attack simulation and training, collaboration security, and agent security powered by AIDA (Artificial Intelligence Defense Agents) and a proprietary Risk Score. The platform leverages 15\-years of behavioral data to combat advanced threats including social engineering, prompt injection, and shadow AI. By securing humans and agents, KnowBe4 leads the industry in workforce trust and defense.
   

  

***Please submit your resume in English.***
 The Senior Director (APAC) will serve as a key strategic HR leader, driving visionary HR strategies across the APAC region in close collaboration and alignment with the CHRO and regional HR peers, while serving as the global HR Business Partner to designated functions. This role will partner directly with C\-level and executive leaders to cultivate organizational excellence and drive business success through innovative people strategies. The Senior Director (APAC) will lead the development and implementation of forward\-thinking HR initiatives, champion change management, ensure compliance, and foster a thriving, high\-performance company culture across both the APAC region and supported global functions. The Senior Director will be instrumental in optimizing talent management, enhancing organizational effectiveness, and empowering a high\-performing HR team while seamlessly collaborating with global HR Directors/Managers and cross\-functional leaders. As the key on\-the\-ground lead for the region, this role will also partner closely with Global Success Hub site leaders to support alignment across core people functions globally. The Senior Director will help drive integrated planning and communication to ensure consistency across locations, while respecting existing departmental ownership of functional workstreams. This position will also be responsible for assisting in the drafting, negotiation and review of a variety of contracts for employment matters in coordination with the KB4 Legal team.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Partner with Global Success Hub site leaders to develop and manage a unified success hub framework and execution timeline spanning organizational structure, benefits, compensation, recruitment, and talent branding, ensuring global synchronization
* Facilitate integrated success hub planning for headcount, capacity, and employee communications to ensure cross\-location alignment, while maintaining existing departmental ownership of functional workstreams
* Draft and implement robust HR policies, procedures and processes in line with KnowBe4’s culture and core values, including the development of the employee handbooks for the International entities
* Continuously monitor and review the effectiveness of all existing HR policies and processes, and make recommendations for improvement as appropriate
* Identify and report on HR\-related risks, making recommendations for managing such risks
* Work collaboratively with the CHRO International, local HR teams and Legal to manage complex employee relations matters including dispute resolutions, disciplinaries, grievances, leaves, absences, retirement, and redundancy in a confidential, lawful, and sensitive manner
* Oversee compliance requirements with regards to employee contracts, bonuses, pensions, required filings, and related matters
* Support the local HR teams in all aspects of benefits administration, selection and coordination with vendors
* Provide advice and coaching, supporting the local HR teams on disciplinary, grievance and other people related matters
* Work in coordination with the Expansion team to assist in their recruitment process
* Represent the company at mediation, arbitration, conciliation, and litigation proceedings, as required
* Advise executives, including senior management, within the company
* Oversee a team of HR Directors \& HR Managers to proactively identify opportunities to enhance the employee experience and help develop and implement innovative solutions
* Work alongside and counsel other departments within the company
* Research and anticipate unique legal issues that could impact the company from a People Operations perspective.
* Research and help to develop strategies to avoid litigation and reduce potential areas of risk


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field or experience required
* Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field or experience preferred
* Minimum 10 years of human resource leadership experience
* Significant experience in both operational and strategic HR, supporting multiple countries preferably in a fast\-growing environment
* Fluent in English and preferable in at least one other language of the countries under this position
* Excellent knowledge of People Operations/HR processes, tools and practices – performance management, compensation and benefits, employee engagement
* Thorough knowledge of applicable employment\-related laws and regulations in the APAC region
* Proficiency with or the ability to quickly learn KnowBe4's HRIS and talent management systems
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Excellent interpersonal, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to prioritize tasks and delegate them when appropriate
* Ability to act with integrity, professionalism, and confidentiality
* Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite or related software.
* Proficient with Google Suite.
* Ability to work both independently and as a team
* Ability to work well under pressure
* Ability to handle high volumes of work at a fast pace
* Must be able to travel to various locations with APAC region and the US office on a 1 or 2 yearly basis


**Our Fantastic Benefits**
 We offer company\-wide bonuses based on monthly sales targets, employee referral bonuses, adoption assistance, tuition reimbursement, certification reimbursement, and certification completion bonuses \- all in a modern, high\-tech, and fun work environment. **Company Description** 
 CompUp (YC S22\) is an AI\-native compensation and workforce planning platform that helps organizations design fair, transparent, and data\-driven Total Rewards programs. Built for modern Total Rewards and People teams, CompUp enables companies to build structured compensation ranges, run budget simulations, and manage compensation cycles end\-to\-end. The platform unifies HRIS, performance, equity, and market data into a single source of truth, making it easier to detect bias and drive pay equity at scale.

The role will partner closely with People, Finance, and business leaders to support compensation planning cycles, model budget and headcount scenarios, and recommend data\-driven pay decisions.

* Strong expertise in Compensation Planning and Compensation Management to support annual and off\-cycle pay decisions, budgeting, and governance.

**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Strategic Domestic HR Leadership \& Workforce Planning** 



* Partner directly with business heads and executive leaders to align headcount planning with national growth objectives.
* Lead organizational restructuring, team integration, and change management initiatives across regional business units.
* Manage Pan\-India HR budgets, workforce analytics, productivity metrics, and regional attrition control programs.



**2\. Domestic \& Tech Talent Acquisition** 



* Lead talent acquisition drives to hire tech (engineering, product, AI), corporate (sales, marketing, finance), and regional field teams across major metro hubs (Mumbai, Bangalore, Delhi NCR).
* Direct executive hiring, campus recruitment programs, and succession planning for business\-critical roles.
* Strengthen the company's employer brand across domestic talent networks, tech communities, and top Indian universities.



**3\. Performance Management \& Total Rewards** 



* Execute continuous performance management frameworks (OKRs/KRAs) to drive accountability across tech and GTM divisions.
* Design competitive domestic compensation benchmarks, annual increment structures, variable pay schemes, and ESOP programs.
* Oversee annual appraisal cycles, performance calibrations, and employee development programs.



**4\. Domestic HR Operations \& HRIS Management** 



* Oversee the deployment and optimization of enterprise HRIS platforms (e.g., Darwinbox, greytHR) for seamless attendance, leave, and payroll processing.
* Streamline employee onboarding, pre\-employment screening (BGV), documentation, and offboarding workflows.
* Lead nationwide employee engagement, internal communication, and workplace culture initiatives.



**5\. Indian Labor Laws \& Statutory Compliance** 



* Ensure strict adherence to Indian labor regulations, Factory Acts, Shops \& Establishment Acts, PF, ESIC, Gratuity, and POSH guidelines across all regional offices.
* Oversee industrial relations, contract labor management, statutory audits, and legal/disciplinary proceedings.
* Manage employee grievance redressal mechanisms and maintain corporate workplace governance.

title: HR Business Partner - BLR
description:
Who Are We?
   

  

 RZR is an AI\-native advertising platform built for the next era of performance marketing. We operate at the intersection of machine learning, programmatic media, and full\-funnel mobile growth, powering campaigns for some of the world's most ambitious advertisers. Our platform is purpose\-built to deliver outcomes at scale, not just impressions.
   

  

 We are a team of builders, operators, and technologists who believe the advertising industry is overdue for a fundamental rethink. We move fast, operate with a high degree of ownership, and hold ourselves to an exceptionally high standard of craft.
   

  

 RZR is scaling aggressively with an active M\&A pipeline and a platform vision that puts us on a path to becoming an industry leader. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at an inflection point and help shape what it becomes.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 As Sr. HR Business Partner (People Business Partner) at RZR, you will serve as the primary strategic People partner for our teams in India, working directly with regional leadership to align people strategy with business goals. This role is critical to enabling planned growth by building strong people practices, driving performance, ensuring compliance, and improving day\-to\-day organizational effectiveness in\-region.
   

  

 This is a highly embedded, hands\-on role. You will work alongside GMs and functional leaders to manage employee relations, run performance cycles, build retention programs, and shape how the organization scales — with a clear mandate to make people decisions that move the business forward.
   

  

 The ideal candidate brings deep HRBP experience, strong commercial instincts, and the confidence to influence and challenge senior leaders. This role offers high visibility and direct impact on how a key international market grows and performs.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 People Partnership
   

  

* Serve as the primary People Partner for the India region, partnering closely with regional leadership to align people strategy with business goals and planned growth
* Drive retention and reduce attrition by proactively identifying talent risks and implementing data\-informed interventions
* Own and execute the end\-to\-end performance management lifecycle, including goal setting, 90\-day reviews, performance cycles, and talent planning
* Establish and reinforce a high\-performance culture with clear expectations, accountability, and differentiation across teams
* Act as a trusted advisor and coach to managers and senior leaders, providing candid guidance on performance, organizational design, and employee engagement
* Lead and manage complex employee relations matters, ensuring timely resolution, risk mitigation, and compliance with local labor laws and regulations
* Operate as a hands\-on partner across the full employee lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, and day\-to\-day employee support
* Maintain HRIS data integrity, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timely updates to support reporting, compliance, and decision\-making
* Identify opportunities to improve and scale People Operations processes, driving efficiency, consistency, and impact
* Leverage HR systems and data to generate insights, inform decision\-making, and enhance overall people practices
* Partner cross\-functionally to ensure alignment and execution of people initiatives across regions


**Required Skills And Experience**
 Must\-Have
   

  

* 7\+ years of experience in a People Partner or Senior People Partner role, preferably in fast\-paced, high\-growth environments (ad tech, gaming, tech, or similar)
* Strong experience supporting international teams, with direct experience in India strongly preferred
* Proven track record managing core HRBP responsibilities including performance management, talent planning, and complex employee relations within local regulatory frameworks
* Demonstrated ability to operate as a hands\-on individual contributor, balancing strategic partnership with day\-to\-day execution
* Experience coaching and influencing senior leaders, with the ability to provide direct, candid feedback and drive decision\-making
* Strong knowledge of local labor laws and employment practices, with the ability to navigate compliance and mitigate risk effectively
* Experience driving process improvements and scaling people programs in growing organizations
* Proficiency with HR systems and tools such as BambooHR, Lattice, or CultureAmp, and comfort using data to inform people decisions
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent experience


 Nice\-to\-Have
   

  

* Experience in ad tech, programmatic advertising, gaming, or platform technology environments
* Exposure to scaling a People function from early\-stage to structured operations
* Experience supporting teams across multiple Indian cities or geographies


 Why Join RZR?
   

  

* High\-impact, embedded ownership — not a shared services role — you will be the sole Sr. HR Business Partner for the India region, with a direct line to regional leadership and a real mandate to shape how the business runs from a people perspective.
* Own the full HRBP scope — performance management, employee relations, retention, organizational design, talent planning, and manager capability are all yours to own and build, not manage from a distance.
* Autonomy to build from scratch — you will have the freedom to design programs, improve processes, and create structure where none exists today, with the visibility to influence decisions at leadership level.
* True strategic partnership in a performance\-driven environment — without the politics of a large HR function. Your work has direct bearing on how the India region grows and performs.
* A function that keeps growing — as the region scales, this role becomes the foundation for a broader People team, with a clear path toward leading it.


 RZR Behaviors
   

  

 RZR operates by eight core behaviors: Extreme Ownership
   

  

* Move Fast
* Drive for Excellence
* Proactive Communication
* Courage
* Curiosity
* Deliver Results
* Manage Ambiguity

description:
Why Join Us?
   

  

**Why Join Us**
 At Check Point, what you do matters. Every day, we protect over 100,000 organizations worldwide from increasingly sophisticated cyber and AI\-driven threats, securing their AI transformation.
   

  

 Our prevention\-first approach safeguards hybrid networks, cloud environments, digital workspaces, and AI systems, stopping attacks before they happen.
   

  

 This is where innovation meets real\-world impact. You’ll help customers across industries operate with confidence in a rapidly changing digital world, working alongside smart, curious people who take ownership, challenge assumptions, and solve complex problems.
   

  

 We’re proud to be recognized by TIME, Newsweek, and Forbes for excellence and workplace culture.
   

  

 What really sets Check Point apart is the opportunity to grow, contribute, and help companies navigate their AI transformation securely.
   

  

 If you’re excited to work at the forefront of AI\-driven security on a global scale, this is the place to do it.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Check Point is seeking an experienced HR Partner to support the India Team and partner closely with the India HR Leader in delivering a seamless employee experience across the employee lifecycle. This role will serve as a trusted HR partner for employees and managers, ensuring operational excellence, compliance, and effective execution of people processes.
   

  

 The HR Generalist will be responsible for end\-to\-end HR operations, employee lifecycle management, employee engagement initiatives, and HR program execution. The role requires strong collaboration with managers, employees, Talent Acquisition, and other People teams to ensure consistent and high\-quality HR service delivery across India.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Key Responsibilities


**Employee Lifecycle Management**
* Manage end\-to\-end employee lifecycle processes including onboarding, confirmations, transfers, promotions, organizational changes, leave management, and offboarding.
* Ensure a seamless employee experience throughout the employee journey.
* Maintain accurate employee records, documentation, and data within HR systems.
* Coordinate onboarding and offboarding activities across stakeholders to ensure smooth transitions.


**HR Operations \& Service Excellence**
* Partner closely with the India HR Leader to execute people processes and HR initiatives across the India organization.
* Serve as the first point of contact for employees and managers on HR policies, processes, and employee lifecycle matters.
* Manage HR transactions and employee data updates with a high degree of accuracy and confidentiality.
* Ensure HR processes are compliant, efficient, and delivered within defined timelines and service standards.
* Maintain HR dashboards, reports, and employee records to support business and compliance requirements.


**Employee Relations \& Manager Support**
* Provide day\-to\-day HR support and guidance to employees and people managers.
* Support employee relations matters and assist with resolution of workplace concerns.
* Guide managers on HR policies, performance management processes, and employee lifecycle activities.
* Foster a positive, inclusive, and engaging workplace culture.


**Employee Engagement \& Culture**
* Partner with the India HR Leader to plan and execute employee engagement, wellness, recognition, and culture\-building initiatives.
* Support employee communications and organizational events.
* Assist in gathering employee feedback and driving actions to enhance employee experience and retention.
* Help strengthen Check Point’s culture and employer brand within the India organization.


**Compliance \& Governance**
* Ensure compliance with applicable labor laws, statutory requirements, and company policies.
* Support audits, compliance reviews, and documentation requirements.
* Maintain awareness of changes in employment legislation and HR best practices.


**HR Projects \& Continuous Improvement**
* Support implementation of annual HR programs including performance management, talent reviews, compensation cycles, and learning initiatives.
* Identify opportunities to streamline HR processes and improve operational effectiveness.
* Partner with global HR teams on HR system enhancements and process improvement projects.
* Contribute to building scalable HR practices that support business growth in India.


**Qualifications**
* Qualifications
+ Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.
+ 5–7 years of progressive HR Generalist experience, preferably within a technology or multinational organization.
+ Strong understanding of employee lifecycle management and HR operations.
+ Working knowledge of Indian labour laws and statutory compliance.
+ Experience with HRIS platforms such as Workday, Oracle, SAP SuccessFactors, or similar systems.
+ Strong stakeholder management, communication, and relationship\-building skills.
+ Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
+ High attention to detail, ownership mindset, and commitment to operational excellence.


**Preferred**
* Experience supporting engineering, product, or technology organizations.
* Exposure to employee engagement and culture\-building initiatives.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently while partnering effectively with business leaders and global HR teams.

description:
****JOB DESCRIPTION****
**Oracle HR Reports Developer**
*HR Technology \| Analytics \& Reporting*
**Department**
 HR Technology
   

  

**Reports To**
 Technical Manager, HR Technology – Platform \& Engineering

 Full\-Time

 Mid to Senior Individual Contributor
   

  

**Platforms**
 Oracle BIP
   

  

* OTBI
* Oracle FDI
* Oracle FAW / Lakehouse


****About The Role****
 The Oracle HR Reports Developer designs and manages enterprise HR reporting and analytics across BIP, OTBI, FDI, and FAW / Lakehouse, turning business requirements into reliable reports, dashboards, data pipelines for global HR, Compensation, Talent, Payroll, and Operations teams.
   

  

 This role partners with the AI System Architect and HR Technology lead to ensure reporting solutions are accurate, scalable, and governance aligned.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
**Oracle BI Publisher (BIP)**
* Design, develop, and maintain BIP reports and templates (RTF, Excel, and eText) for HCM, Talent, Benefits, and Compensation.
* Build and optimize data models, SQL queries, and flexfield\-based reporting solutions.
* Configure report bursting, scheduling, and automated distribution.
* Develop regulatory, compliance, audit, and operational reporting extracts.
* Manage BIP catalog governance, security, version control, and environment migrations.


**Oracle Transactional Business Intelligence (OTBI)**
* Develop and maintain OTBI analysis, dashboards, KPIs, and self\-service reporting solutions across Oracle HCM modules.
* Design user\-friendly analytics using filters, prompts, hierarchical views, and interactive dashboards.
* Govern OTBI content through catalog administration, naming standards, usage audits, and lifecycle management.
* Enable business self\-service reporting through user support, training, and best\-practice guidance.
* Assess and remediate report impacts resulting from Oracle quarterly releases and subject area changes.


**Oracle Data Intelligence (FDI)**
* Design, develop, and maintain enterprise\-grade FDI dashboards, reports, and analytics solutions supporting HR, Finance, Compensation, Talent Management, and Workforce Planning functions.
* Configure and manage FDI subject areas, semantic model extensions (SME), custom calculations, KPIs, dimensions, and measures to meet evolving business reporting requirements.
* Implement and troubleshoot FDI security, including row\-level security, data access roles, Area of Responsibility (AOR)\-based security, and custom subject\-area access controls.
* Develop interactive dashboards, visualizations, drill\-through analyses, and executive scorecards for leadership teams and business stakeholders.
* Integrate data from Oracle Fusion HCM, Payroll, Recruiting, Compensation, and Workforce Management modules into unified analytics and reporting solutions.
* Support quarterly Oracle releases, regression testing, validation activities, and production issue resolution for FDI analytics environments.


**Oracle Fusion Analytics Warehouse (FAW) / Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW)**
* Configure, administer, and optimize Oracle Fusion Analytics Warehouse (FAW) environments, including pipeline activation, data synchronization, incremental refresh schedules, and semantic model enhancements.
* Extend the FAW/FDI Lakehouse architecture by ingesting and integrating non\-Oracle HR and workforce data sources—including Eightfold AI, Celergo, ADP GlobalView, compensation benchmarking platforms, and other third\-party applications—into Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW) using ODI, OCI Object Storage, APIs, and custom ETL frameworks.
* Develop and maintain custom ADW data models, staging structures, and transformation processes to support advanced reporting and cross\-functional analytics.
* Design and publish workforce analytics dashboards covering headcount, attrition, hiring, promotions, compensation, diversity, compliance, and organizational effectiveness metrics.
* Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines, refresh jobs, synchronization failures, schema changes, and data quality issues across FDI, FAW, ADW, and ODI environments.
* Maintain data governance standards, documentation, lineage tracking, security policies, and audit\-compliant access controls across analytics platforms.


**Cross\-Platform \& Governance**
* Maintain reporting inventory, ownership, data classification, and refresh schedules.
* Administer row\-level security (RLS) and role\-based access controls.
* Support analytics data integration from Boomi, HCM Extracts, and other enterprise sources.
* Lead regression testing and remediation activities for Oracle quarterly releases.
* Contribute to HR analytics and AI reporting strategy through continuous improvement and innovation.
* Maintain technical documentation, data dictionaries, operational procedures, and support runbooks.
* Provide end\-user support, troubleshoot system defects, and promote reporting best practices.
* Analyze business requirements, identify process improvements, and assess downstream impacts.
* Serve as a subject matter expert on reporting platforms, data models, and analytics solutions.
* Mentor, coach, and share knowledge with team members to build organizational capability.
* Responsible for working on critical defects and product enhancement requests, Production issues


****Required Qualifications****
* 5\+ years of Oracle HCM reporting and analytics experience in a SaaS environment.
* Hands\-on expertise with Oracle BI Publisher (BIP), including data models, SQL, flexfields, bursting, and report development.
* Strong experience designing and maintaining BIP templates (RTF, Excel, and eText).
* Advanced knowledge of OTBI analyses, dashboards, KPIs, and Oracle HCM subject areas.
* Proficiency in Oracle SQL and PL/SQL for reporting, analytics, and data extraction.
* Experience with Oracle FDI, FAW, or Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC), including dashboard development and semantic modeling.
* Understanding data warehousing concepts, including dimensional modeling and incremental data loads.
* Ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable reporting and analytics solutions.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and data validation skills with a focus on data accuracy and governance.


****Preferred Qualifications****
* Experience with Oracle Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI) and workforce analytics solutions.
* Knowledge of Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW), Lakehouse architecture, and external data integrations.
* Experience with Power BI or similar enterprise analytics platforms.
* Understanding of HR data governance, privacy, and security controls.
* Oracle Cloud HCM Reports and Analytics certification preferred.
* Exposure to AI\-enabled analytics, predictive insights, and dashboard automation.
* Experience supporting global HCM environments with multi\-country reporting and compliance needs.
* Strong stakeholder management, training, and knowledge\-sharing skills.
* Experience with HCM Extracts and enterprise reporting integrations.


**Location:**
* Bangalore, India — Hybrid


****What Success Looks Like — First 12 Months****
* Day 90: Complete audit of existing BIP and OTBI catalog; deliver documented report inventory with owner mapping and data source lineage
* Day 90: Establish BIP template governance standards and naming conventions adopted by the broader team
* Month 6: Deliver regression testing framework for quarterly Oracle patch cycles — zero undetected reporting breaks post\-upgrade
* Month 6: Complete first FAW Lakehouse extension ingesting a non\-Oracle HR data source (e.g., Eightfold skills data or Celergo headcount feed)
* Month 12: Launch OTBI self\-service enablement program reducing ad hoc developer report requests by 30%
* Month 12: Publish unified people \+ finance dashboard combining FDI and OTBI data, trusted by both HR and Finance leadership


**Team \& Working Environment**
 You will join a lean, high\-impact HR Technology team operating at the intersection of enterprise HR systems, AI strategy, and data engineering. The team manages a complex integration landscape of 50\+ integrations spanning Oracle HCM, Boomi, ServiceNow HRSD, ADP GlobalView, Celergo, Eightfold AI, Saviynt, and Azure AD. Reporting and Analytics sits within a structured three\-layer data architecture alongside a Data Engineer (pipelines) and an AI Architect (agents and models).
   

  

 The team follows a fast\-follower AI posture, with Oracle AI Agent Studio (26B) as the approved AI platform. The Analytics function is expected to consume and surface AI agent outputs within reporting workflows as the capability matures. You will operate under Fortive's enterprise data governance standards and within Oracle HCM's quarterly release cadence (currently 26B).
   

  

 Fortive Corporation
   

  

* HR Technology


*This job description is not exhaustive and may be subject to change based on business needs.*
****Fortive Corporation Overview****
 Fortive’s essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high\-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.
   

  

 We are a global industrial technology innovator with a startup spirit. description:
**Description**
 At Amazon, HR Partners (HRP) provide high\-judgment HR support to managers across levels at scale, enabling them to become force multipliers for customer impact and positive employee experience. They demonstrate advanced knowledge of HR policies, processes, and tools, acting as trusted consultants to managers and senior managers. HRPs work backwards from the voice of the manager to deliver personalized experiences and drive large\-scale initiatives using technology and simplified processes that match the speed and agility of our business. They operate independently as subject matter experts with deep knowledge of regional programs and policies, collaborating extensively with PXT teams including HR Business Partners, Employee Relations, Legal, and others to provide integrated people solutions. As established practitioners, they mentor junior team members and shape best practices across the region.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Managers and senior managers collaborate with Senior HR Partners to support sensitive and often complex employee issues including disciplinary, performance improvement and grievance processes. The Sr. HRP acts as an influential partner in helping managers with talent and performance management processes, people development, HR policies and implementation of organizational changes at the country or regional level. Thanks to their front\-line visibility across businesses, Sr. HRPs are in a position to spot trends, identify emerging needs and address them in collaboration with the appropriate business and HR stakeholders. Sr. HRPs are also expected to partner on complex global and regional strategic priorities and process improvement initiatives. As a subject matter expert, Sr. HRPs mentor and guide junior team members.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities Include**
* Performance Management: Partner with managers on complex and nuanced performance management cases including performance improvement plans and assessments. Guide managers in implementing performance management processes and tools effectively. Partner with managers to ensure bias\-free evaluations and effective coaching approaches across teams. Analyze performance data to identify trends, share insights, and develop solutions for systemic issues.
* Employee Relations: Handle complex and nuanced employee relations cases and investigations following established processes and policies. Conduct thorough and impartial investigations, support grievance processes, and lead informal discussions or mediation. Provide guidance to managers on sophisticated ER matters including policy violations and workplace concerns across countries. Partner with Legal and Employee Relations teams to resolve sensitive cases while ensuring compliance and risk mitigation. Analyze investigation findings, prepare recommendations, and identify trends to prevent future risks.
* HR General: Act as stewards of the employee experience and Amazon’s culture. Act as subject matter expert for people tools, processes, programs or projects. Design and deliver Manager Education initiatives to further drive collective education and manager effectiveness. Analyze data and observations across the organization, highlighting trends and recommending/driving solutions, as appropriate.
* Change Management: Drive implementation of employee programs and lead improvements in manager experience. Partner with HR Business Partners and central teams on complex change initiatives across countries. Use data and insights to advocate for and influence process improvements. Design and execute change management strategies to ensure effective adoption across diverse employee groups.
* Process Improvement: Drive complex strategic priorities and process improvement initiatives across India. Partner with global HRP team, other HR teams and CoEs to drive global and regional HRP strategic projects.


 This role is performed through an innovative customer relationship Management tool that enables this team to be uniquely positioned to identify trending issues and themes through data and inform consequent decisions and initiatives.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in business, HR, or a related field, or 5\+ years of human resources experience and Bachelor's degree
* Experience delivering results by partnering with and influencing others
* Experience coaching and mentoring at the management level
* Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment
* Experience in computer skills, including proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
* Experience working effectively across cross\-functional teams and partnering well with people at all levels within an organization
* Business and HR acumen, including problem solving skills, critical thinking, and self\-initiative


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree in Human Resources or related field with about 6\-10 years’ work experience. Proven track record of accomplishments in a dynamic environment, which is fast paced and customer driven. Proven ability to prioritize, meet deadlines and make the best use of available resources. Project management and the ability to deliver, with a proven track record of influencing through data\-driven recommendations. Coaching and consulting skills; Ability to work with and influence multiple stakeholders. Experience in dealing with contingent workforce will be an advantage. Presentation skills and knowledge of employment laws.

**What You'll Do**
**Employee Relations \& Experience**
* Be the go\-to HR partner for employees across your business groups \- accessible, trusted, and genuinely invested in their experience.
* Manage employee relations matters with fairness and sound judgment: workplace concerns, conflict resolution, and investigations where required.
* Conduct stay interviews and listening sessions; surface themes and insights to HR leadership with a clear point of view on what needs to move.

* Serve as the primary HR contact for managers \- advising on people decisions, policy interpretation, team dynamics, and employee situations.
* Equip managers with the tools, frameworks, and confidence to lead their teams effectively.

* Own the talent management agenda for your business groups \- from identifying capability gaps today to building the pipeline the business needs tomorrow.
* Design and maintain competency frameworks that define what great looks like at every level; keep them connected to hiring and real career conversations, not just documentation.

* Partner with HR leadership and external vendors to design, source, and deliver learning programs that build capability at scale.
* Track the impact of development investments \- participation, application, and outcomes \- and use that data to improve what's working and cut what isn't.
* Support internal mobility by helping employees understand career pathways and actively connecting talent to opportunities across the business.
* Build a culture of continuous feedback and development within your business groups \- making growth a lived experience, not an annual event.


**Performance \& Feedback Culture**
* Support the annual and mid\-year performance process \- ensuring meaningful participation, consistent execution, and clear outcomes.
* Coach managers and employees through goal\-setting, feedback, and development conversations.
* Identify trends emerging from performance cycles and share insights with HR leadership.

* 6–9 years of progressive HR experience in a People Partner, HRBP, or Employee Relations role.
* Strong employee relations instincts \- you know how to hold a difficult conversation and reach a fair outcome.
* Track record of building trusted relationships with managers and employees at all levels.
* Experience supporting talent development, career frameworks, and performance processes.
* Comfortable working in a lean team where you own your domain end\-to\-end.
* Experience in a B2B SaaS or tech company.


**YOU’LL THRIVE HERE IF**
* You're energised by the complexity of people and organisations \- no two situations are the same and that's what keeps you engaged.
* You give advice that leaders actually take because it's grounded, practical, and delivered with confidence.
* You believe great HR partnership makes the business better, not just more compliant.

**AI Adoption \& Change Strategy**
* Design and execute a unified AI change strategy across GCCs (India, , Mexico, Colombia, Manila).
* Translate WSP global AI initiatives into localized adoption plans aligned with workforce maturity and delivery models.
* Drive AI training and enablement leveraging global and vendor capabilities.
* Define phased adoption waves: Learn → Apply → Scale → Optimize.
* Establish a repeatable operating model for AI rollouts

* Oversee and assess the impact of AI tools (e.g., generative design, document intelligence, analytics) on existing workflows.
* Define and document future ways of working across WSP enterprise platforms (ERP, engineering, custom apps).
* Support creation of future AI ?role profiles and competency frameworks


**Stakeholder Engagement**
* Manage a complex stakeholder ecosystem within WSP including GCC leadership, project delivery teams, WSP global AI sponsors, and support function i.e. HR/IT/Risk .
* Act as the primary change interface between GCCs and WSP global AI program offices.
* Execute targeted communication strategies for:
+ Leadership: value, risk, ROI
+ Delivery: productivity, quality, capacity
+ Engineers: usability, trust, skill growth

* Proactively address limitations, resistance, job displacement concerns, and trust issues

* Conduct AI readiness and sentiment diagnostics across workforce segments.
* Partner with HR/L\&D to design role\-based learning pathways.
* Build and scale AI Change Champions / Super Users.
* Equip targeted groups and managers with toolkits to lead AI\-driven transformation.


**Adoption Measurement \& Reporting**
* Define and track AI adoption KPIs such as:
+ Tool utilization and frequency
+ Time\-to\-proficiency
+ Productivity and cycle time improvements
+ Quality and rework reduction
+ Engineer experience

* Run adoption health checks and pulse surveys.
* Report progress with dashboards and actionable insights for leadership


**Governance, Risk \& Responsible AI Enablement**
* Ensure responsible AI adoption aligned with best practice governance, security, and risk policies.
* Support development of guardrails, playbooks, and acceptable\-use guidelines.
* Educate teams on ethical AI, bias awareness, and escalation mechanisms.
* Support audits and governance reviews as the change lead.


**Qualifications**
**Required Skills \& Experience**
**Core Experience**
* 10–15\+ years in change management, operating model design, or process consulting in GCC environments.
* Proven ability to drive large\-scale, multi\-country transformation programs.
* Experience in data analytics, AI, ML, or automation initiatives.


**AI \& Digital Transformation Skills**
* Strong understanding of enterprise AI (automation, analytics, workflow transformation).

**Analytical \& Execution Skills**
* Data\-driven approach to defining KPIs and measuring adoption.

* Strong execution mindset with ability to manage ambiguity and evolving AI maturity


**Overall Value Proposition**
 This role is critical in enabling GCCs to transition from AI experimentation to scaled, value\-driven adoption, ensuring measurable improvements in productivity, quality, and workforce capability while maintaining governance and trust.

description:
A leading European manufacturer is setting up an India shared\-services centre, and the HR pillar of that centre is being built from the ground up over the next two quarters. Flexiple is a managed marketplace that helps global companies build high\-performing teams and GCCs in India, and this manufacturer has engaged Flexiple to hire the HR Manager who will lead that build.
 



**The remit** 




 This is not a caretaker role. You will design the HR operating model for a plant\-adjacent, shared\-services population that will grow from around eighty to over two hundred and fifty people, spanning finance, engineering support and customer service functions housed in the same centre.
 



**What the team is building** 



* Onboarding and induction that works for both office staff and shift\-based plant liaisons
* A performance and rewards framework aligned to the parent company's global structure but adapted for Indian market benchmarks
* HR service delivery processes, covering query management, documentation and letters, that can scale without adding headcount linearly



**How the work actually happens** 




 Expect a lot of ambiguity in month one: policies will need to be written, not just administered, and you will be the one drafting the leave policy, the travel policy and the exit process from close to nothing. You will work directly with the global HR director in Europe on anything that needs headquarters sign\-off, and with local labour law counsel on anything that does not.
 



**Who fits this** 




 You will have six to nine years of HR generalist experience, including at least one stint where you built a function rather than inherited one. Manufacturing, shared\-services or GCC background is preferred, and comfort with English and Hindi is expected given the plant\-adjacent stakeholder group, with additional regional language ability a bonus.
 



**Where you will sit** 




 This role is based in Pune or Chennai, given proximity to the manufacturing footprint, with Remote (India) workable for a candidate willing to travel to site every few weeks.
 



**Getting there** 




 The process runs through an initial HR conversation, a task where you sketch out a real policy, a round with the plant and functional stakeholders, and a final conversation on fit.
 



 Flexiple will also keep this profile in view for other India HR\-build mandates as they open, beyond this one role.

title: Lead - People intelligence
description:
**Lead, People Intelligence:\-**
 A senior analytics role at the heart of People Intelligence \& Tech Transformation. You will turn Sapiens' people, commercial, and organisational data into the intelligence that helps leaders see the company clearly and decide with evidence. This is hands\-on analytical work — you model, analyse, and tell the story. You are fluent with modern AI tools and comfortable inside HR systems, and you use both to do sharper analysis, faster.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
**People intelligence on large, complex data**
* Work with large, multi\-source HR datasets — HRIS, ATS, LMS, payroll, engagement surveys, performance, compensation — across grades, geographies, and functions.
* Run diagnostic analyses on the questions— the drivers of attrition and where it concentrates, bottlenecks and drop\-off in the hiring funnel, the relationship between organisational structure and team performance, the impact of learning on behaviour, movements in productivity, and patterns in pay etc.
* Build workforce planning and scenario models — projecting the size, shape, and cost of the workforce needed to deliver the business strategy over time, and running simulations that let leaders test different growth, structure, and efficiency scenarios against real data.
* Own compensation analytics end\-to\-end — comp\-ratio and range\-penetration analysis, internal pay equity, and bonus and total\-cost modelling.
* Design and maintain composite people metrics and indices that connect workforce data to business outcomes, with sound methodology, clear weighting, stable baselines, and a defined refresh cadence.
* Build the dashboards and reporting that leaders genuinely use — spanning headcount, attrition, hiring, internal mobility, diversity, engagement, productivity (including revenue and profit per employee), and leadership health — designed for decisions, not just for record\-keeping.


**Data storytelling**
* Turn analysis into a clear narrative — the finding, the evidence, what it means, and a recommended action — pitched for senior decision\-makers who need to act on it quickly.
* Communicate with clarity and precision in writing: a problem framed in a few sentences, a recommendation that stands on its own, and analysis documented well enough to stand up to scrutiny and be picked up by others later.
* Maintain the analytics playbook — definitions, metric logic, methodology notes, and documentation — so the work is consistent, repeatable, and easy for others to understand and build on


**What You Will Bring**
* 5–7 years across people analytics, HR analytics, or analytics consulting, with meaningful time spent analysing people or workforce data. You operate independently — someone a leader can hand a question to and trust to return with an answer that holds up.
* Comfort with large, multi\-source datasets. You have wrangled, joined, and reconciled HR data across systems and geographies, and you know how data lies when nobody is checking.
* Strong technical toolkit: advanced Excel (modelling, Power Query, statistical functions), SQL fluency, Power BI or equivalent. Python or R for data wrangling and applied statistics — pandas, numpy, scipy, statsmodels, or R equivalents.
* A strong grasp of statistical fundamentals — descriptive statistics, correlation, regression, significance testing, sampling. Enough to test a hypothesis, not just describe a number.
* Data storytelling that actually lands. You can take a complex analysis and reduce it to a one\-page narrative a non\-analytical leader will understand and act on.
* Hands\-on experience working within HRMS platforms and a strong grasp of core HR process flows — hire\-to\-retire, comp cycles, performance management, engagement surveys. You know what data lives in these systems and how the processes behind it work.
* Demonstrable, current AI fluency. You use LLMs and agentic tools every day and can talk credibly about what they do well, where they fail, and where they do not belong. You do not need to have built production AI systems; you do need to use these tools fluently to sharpen your own work.
* Sharp written and verbal communication in English.


**Nice to have**
* Experience at a global SaaS or product company.
* Exposure to survey analytics platforms — Glint, Qualtrics, or Culture Amp.
* Organisational network analysis or text analytics on unstructured HR data.
* Experience building or contributing to composite people indices.
* Working knowledge of a major HRMS — SuccessFactors, Workday, Oracle HCM, or HiBob — at the level of pulling clean data out of it. You do not need to configure it; you do need to know what is in it.

**Company Description**
 Founded in 2018, Lokal is on a mission to strengthen hyperlocal communities by enabling its mostly non\-English users to share, interact and transact in their regional language. Lokal users gain access to hyperlocal information such as daily commodity prices, local jobs, real estate, matrimonial, local business advertorials and classifieds which would otherwise be scattered across local newspapers. The app is available in Kannada, Telugu, Tamil, Malayalam and Marathi, and has 10 million downloads with a presence in 100\+ districts across South India. Having achieved unmatched user density in deep tier 2 \& 3 locations in India, Lokal has been supported by marquee investors, namely 3one4 Capital, India Quotient, Y Combinator.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Role Overview :**
 We are looking for a Senior HRBP to partner closely with GyanTV leadership and own the people's agenda across organisation effectiveness, talent, performance, manager capability, employee relations and culture.

* 5–8 years of progressive HR experience with strong HRBP ownership.

* Strong business acumen and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Good understanding of organisation design, performance, talent, ER and workforce planning.

 Innovative thinking, delivery excellence and thought leadership to help our clients transform their business. Together with our clients and industry partners, we deliver disruptive work that is changing energy and financial services.

***Role Description :***




**Job Description – HR Business Partner (HRBP)** 




**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an experienced and people\-focused
 **HR Business Partner (HRBP)** 
 to manage end\-to\-end HR responsibilities for designated accounts/business units, drive location\-level HR initiatives, and contribute to strategic HR projects. title: Manager HRBP
description:
Manager – HR Business Partner
 



**Location:** 
 Bengaluru
 



**Experience:** 
 5–8 Years
 



**Function:** 
 Human Resources
 



**Role Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Head – Human Resources
 



  





**Role Summary** 




 We are looking for a
 **Manager – HR Business Partner** 
 to partner with business leaders and managers in building a high\-performing, engaged, and talent\-driven organization.
 



 This role will be responsible for translating business priorities into
 **people strategies and interventions** 
 , with primary ownership across
 **Employee Relations \& Engagement, Talent Development, and Performance Management** 
 .
 



 The ideal candidate will bring strong business acumen, sound judgment, and the ability to influence leaders, coach managers, and drive people initiatives from
 **diagnosis to execution and measurable outcomes** 
 .
 



  





 What You Will Own
 



 01 \| Employee Relations \& Engagement
 



 Build a strong employee experience and create an environment where employees can perform at their best.
 


* Partner with leaders and managers to proactively identify and resolve employee and team\-level people challenges.
* Own employee relations matters including grievances, conflicts, disciplinary situations, and sensitive employee concerns.
* Build strong employee connects through structured 1:1s, skip\-level interactions, pulse checks, and engagement forums.
* Identify patterns across engagement, attrition, employee sentiment, and manager effectiveness and translate insights into action.
* Design and drive initiatives that strengthen engagement, culture, retention, and employee experience.
* Coach managers through complex people situations and enable them to become stronger people leaders.
* Act as a trusted and objective advisor to both employees and business leaders.



 02 \| Talent Development
 



 Build a strong internal talent pipeline and create meaningful growth opportunities for employees.
 


* Partner with business leaders to identify critical capabilities, talent gaps, and future talent requirements.
* Identify high\-potential and critical talent and create structured development plans.
* Drive Individual Development Plans, career conversations, internal mobility, and capability\-building initiatives.
* Partner with leaders to develop succession plans for critical roles.
* Design and implement leadership and manager development interventions.
* Identify emerging talent and create differentiated development journeys based on individual and business needs.
* Measure the effectiveness of talent interventions through defined business and people outcomes.



 03 \| Performance Management
 



 Build a culture of high performance, accountability, and continuous feedback.
 


* Own the performance management agenda for assigned business functions.
* Partner with leaders and managers on goal setting, KRAs/KPIs, performance reviews, calibration, and feedback mechanisms.
* Ensure performance expectations are clear, measurable, and aligned with business priorities.
* Coach managers on delivering effective feedback and having high\-quality performance conversations.
* Identify performance gaps and drive structured interventions, including Performance Improvement Plans where required.
* Use performance data to identify high performers, underperformance, capability gaps, and talent risks.
* Strengthen a culture of continuous feedback, ownership, accountability, and performance differentiation.



  





 HR Business Partnership
 



 Beyond the core pillars, you will serve as a strategic people partner to the business.
 


* Develop a deep understanding of the business, operating model, teams, and growth priorities.
* Translate business challenges into practical and scalable people solutions.
* Partner with leadership on workforce planning, organization effectiveness, team structures, and people priorities.
* Provide data\-backed insights on attrition, engagement, performance, talent, and workforce trends.
* Challenge and influence business leaders and managers on people decisions when required.
* Drive organization\-wide HR initiatives within assigned business units and ensure strong adoption.
* Partner closely with Talent Acquisition, HR Operations, L\&D, and other HR teams to deliver an integrated employee experience.
* Support organizational change and transformation initiatives as the business evolves.



  





 What We're Looking For
 



**Experience \& Background** 



* 5–8 years of experience in
 **HR Business Partnering / People Partnering** 
 , preferably in a high\-growth organization.
* Strong hands\-on experience across
 **Employee Relations, Performance Management, and Talent Development** 
 .
* Experience partnering directly with business leaders and senior people managers.
* Demonstrated experience in managing complex employee relations and performance situations.
* Experience building or improving performance management and talent development frameworks.
* Strong exposure to employee engagement and retention initiatives.



**Capabilities** 



* Strong business acumen with the ability to understand people challenges in the context of business outcomes.
* Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Strong coaching and conflict\-resolution capabilities.
* Data\-driven approach to identifying and solving people problems.
* High degree of ownership and ability to operate independently.
* Strong judgment, discretion, and maturity in handling sensitive employee matters.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-paced, ambiguous, and continuously evolving environment.



  





 What Success Looks Like
 



 In the first 12–18 months, success in this role will be reflected through:
 


* **Higher employee engagement and stronger employee experience**
* **Improved manager effectiveness and quality of people leadership**
* **Stronger performance management discipline and accountability**
* **Improved identification and development of high\-potential talent**
* **Stronger internal talent pipeline and career mobility**
* **Effective resolution of employee relations matters**
* **Reduction in avoidable and regrettable attrition**
* **Business leaders viewing HR as a strategic partner rather than a support function**



  





 Core Competencies
 



**Employee Relations \| Employee Engagement \| Talent Development \| Performance Management \| HR Business Partnering \| Manager Coaching \| Stakeholder Management \| Talent Management \| Conflict Resolution \| Organizational Effectiveness \| Data\-driven Decision Making \| Change Management** 




  





 The Profile We Want
 



 We are looking for someone who is
 **not just an HR process owner** 
 .
 



 You should be someone who can walk into a business team, understand
 **what is happening, why it is happening, and what needs to change** 
 — and then work with leaders and managers to make that change happen.
 



**Strong HR judgment \+ Business understanding \+ Data orientation \+ Ability to influence \= Strong HRBP**

Still founder\-led by Chairman and CEO Richard Fairbank, we dare to dream, disrupt and deliver a better way for our customers, the financial industry and for each other. Our goal is simple – bring ingenuity, simplicity and humanity to an industry ripe for change.
   

  

 At Capital One India, we solve fundamental business problems at scale using advanced analytics, data science and machine learning. We specialize in deriving valuable insights about various aspects of the business \- including product and process design, consumer behavior, regulatory and credit risk, and much more \- from large volumes of data to build cutting edge patentable products at an industrial scale.
