title: Learning Business Partner
description:
**About the Company** 




  





 Quantiphi is an AI\-first digital engineering company that leverages artificial intelligence, machine learning, and cloud technologies to solve complex business problems and drive innovation across diverse industries. They specialize in building data platforms and developing custom AI solutions, primarily on Google Cloud Platform, to deliver measurable business outcomes.
 



  





**What This Role Is** 




 This is not a training coordinator role. It is not a curriculum administrator role.
 



 We are looking for a Learning Business Partner who operates as a learning solutions architect. Someone who sits with a business unit leader, diagnoses the real capability gap, designs the intervention, builds it, ships it, and proves it worked.
 



 You will own a portfolio of internal business units. For each one, you are the single point of accountability for capability. You will understand their delivery pressures, their hiring plans, their client commitments, and their skill gaps well enough to propose solutions before they ask.
 



 You will also be expected to go outside the company for talent. When the expertise does not exist internally, you will find the practitioner who has it, reach them directly, and bring them in.
 



*A partner who takes requests is a service desk. A partner who builds solutions is a multiplier. We are hiring for the second.* 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**1\. Business Partnership and Diagnosis** 



* Own a defined portfolio of business units and functions as their primary L\&D partner.
* Build direct working relationships with unit leaders, delivery heads, and practice owners. Earn a seat in their planning conversations, not just their training requests.
* Diagnose capability gaps using business evidence. Delivery metrics, client feedback, deployment readiness, attrition patterns, project staffing constraints. Not survey data alone.
* Distinguish problems that learning can solve from problems it cannot. Say so clearly when the answer is a process fix, a hiring decision, or a management conversation.
* Translate business goals into capability requirements. Translate capability requirements into learning solutions with defined outcomes.
* Challenge poorly framed requests. When a leader asks for a two\-day workshop, your job is to ask what changes on Monday if it works.



  





**2\. Solution Architecture and Build** 



* Architect end\-to\-end learning solutions across modalities. Instructor\-led, digital, cohort\-based, on\-the\-job, coaching, assessment, certification.
* Build the solution yourself. This role is hands\-on. You will write learning objectives, structure content, design assessments, build assets, and configure delivery. You will not hand a brief to someone else and wait.
* Design role\-based learning paths for technical and business roles. Data Engineering, Machine Learning Engineering, Cloud and Backend Engineering, Prompt Engineering, Test Automation, Business Analysis, Software Development, and roles that do not exist yet.
* Integrate AI tools, agentic workflows, and applied AI concepts as a foundational layer across solutions, not as a bolt\-on module.
* Use AI to build faster. We expect you to work with LLMs, authoring tools, and automation to compress design cycles. Craft matters. So does speed.
* Design assessment and gating logic. Every solution needs a way to tell who is ready and who is not.
* Reuse before you rebuild. Maintain a modular content library so solutions compose rather than start from zero.



  





**3\. External Practitioner Sourcing and Negotiation** 



* Use LinkedIn Recruiter fluently. Build Boolean and filtered searches, run projects, manage pipelines, track response rates, and refine sourcing strategy based on what converts.
* Identify practising experts in the market who can teach. Distinguish credible practitioners from professional trainers with thin field experience.
* Write InMail that senior practitioners actually answer. Personalised, specific, and short.
* Negotiate directly on scope, rate, delivery dates, intellectual property, and quality expectations. Close the engagement without escalating every conversation.
* Build and maintain a standing bench of external Subject Matter Experts, freelance trainers, and boutique vendors who can be mobilised at short notice.
* Manage commercial hygiene. Contracting, purchase orders, invoicing, and vendor onboarding, working with Procurement and Finance.
* Hold external practitioners to the same delivery and quality standard as internal SMEs. Exit the ones who do not meet it.



  





**4\. Delivery Ownership** 



* Be fully accountable for delivery of every solution in your portfolio. No session goes undelivered.
* Identify, engage, and manage internal Subject Matter Experts. Build a named backup for every critical session before the calendar is published.
* Bring in external SMEs, vendors, and freelance trainers when internal capacity is insufficient.
* Facilitate sessions yourself where it is the right call. You should be able to hold a room of 100 plus learners and be credible with a technical audience.
* Run multiple cohorts and parallel tracks without dropping operational quality.



  





**5\. Measurement and Impact** 



* Define success metrics with the business leader before the solution is built, not after it is delivered.
* Instrument every solution. Track completion, capability movement, and business outcome.
* Report to leadership in the language of impact. Deployment readiness, billable ramp time, certification attainment, client feedback. Not attendance counts.
* Kill solutions that do not work. Scale the ones that do.



  





**6\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 



* Work with Talent Acquisition on the capability implications of hiring plans, and share sourcing intelligence gathered from the external market.
* Work with delivery leadership on bench readiness and redeployment.
* Work with practice leads on certification targets and partner requirements.
* Contribute to the L\&D operating model. Share what you build. Improve what others built.



  





**Required Skills and Qualifications** 




  





**Business Partnering** 



* Proven experience acting as a strategic partner to senior business stakeholders, not an order taker.
* Ability to influence without authority. You will have no formal power over the leaders you serve.
* Comfort with commercial context. You should understand how the business makes money and how capability affects that.
* Skill in reframing requests, managing pushback, and holding a position when the evidence supports it.
* Track record of turning a vague business complaint into a scoped, measurable intervention.



  





**Solution Design and Build** 



* Exceptional instructional design skills. Strong pedagogical and aesthetic judgment. Learning experiences must be engaging, well structured, and effective.
* Demonstrated experience building structured, multi\-week programs for technical and professional audiences.
* Fluency in writing role\-specific learning objectives and converting them into practical content.
* Hands\-on ability with authoring tools, LMS platforms, assessment design, and content production.
* Experience designing for measurable behaviour change, not content completion.
* Strong understanding of adult learning principles and how to apply them under real delivery constraints.



  





**Sourcing, Negotiation, and Vendor Management** 



* Demonstrated hands\-on experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, including Boolean search, projects, InMail campaigns, and pipeline management. Working knowledge of LinkedIn Sales Navigator or comparable sourcing tools is an advantage.
* Proven track record of cold outreach to senior external practitioners with a credible response rate.
* Direct experience negotiating commercial terms with freelancers, consultants, and training vendors.
* Ability to assess practitioner credibility from a profile, a portfolio, and a thirty minute conversation.
* Experience running a vendor bench with documented backup coverage for every critical delivery.
* Comfort with contracting workflows, rate benchmarking, and procurement processes.



  





**Technical Credibility** 



* Working knowledge of foundational concepts across at least three of the following: Data Engineering, Machine Learning Engineering, Software Engineering, Cloud Platforms (GCP or AWS), Business Analysis, Test Automation.
* Practical familiarity with LLMs, prompt engineering, agentic systems, and AI\-assisted development workflows.
* Ability to read a technical curriculum, assess its quality, and hold your own in a design conversation with a senior engineer.
* Understanding of industry certifications and technical competency frameworks.



  





**Delivery Assurance and Program Management** 



* Proven ability to identify, engage, and manage internal and external Subject Matter Experts.
* Experience building SME backup strategies that guarantee zero disruption to live delivery.
* Track record of maintaining continuity in high\-pressure, resource\-constrained conditions.
* Ability to run multiple portfolios, cohorts, and tracks in parallel.
* Strong organisational discipline across scheduling, resourcing, tracking, and reporting.
* Comfort with LMS platforms, project management tools, and reporting systems.



  





**Communication** 



* Strong written and verbal communication in English.
* Confidence presenting to senior leadership and defending a design decision.
* Skill in translating learning outcomes into business impact metrics.
* Ability to write short, sharp progress updates that a busy leader will actually read.
* Experience facilitating workshops and stakeholder alignment sessions.



  





**Experience Requirements** 



* 7 to 9 years in Learning and Development, capability building, technical training, or learning consulting.
* Prior experience as a Learning Business Partner, HR Business Partner, learning consultant, or solutions architect is strongly preferred.
* Experience in a technology company, AI and data services firm, or professional services environment is a significant advantage.
* Demonstrated success building capability programs from the ground up, not inheriting and maintaining them.
* Track record of managing delivery for cohorts of 50 or more learners.
* Experience in fast\-paced, high\-growth organisations where scope changes and priorities move.
* Prior exposure to multi\-location delivery and distributed teams is a plus.

title: Human Resources Generalist
description:
**About Us** 




 Ushur delivers the world's first Customer Experience Automation platform built specifically for regulated industries. With guardrails and compliance\-ready infrastructure, Ushur powers vertical AI Agents for healthcare, financial services and insurance.
 



 Founded in 2014 and headquartered in Santa Clara, California, Ushur is backed by Third Point Ventures, Tiger Global, 8VC, Iron Pillar, Aflac Ventures and Pentland Ventures, with a sizeable Fortune 500 customer base. Our Bengaluru office is one of two principal locations and is central to how the company is built and run.
 



 We build AI agents for regulated enterprises, and we run our own operations the same way.
 



**About Ushur
 
 l
 
 Ushur GenAI**




**Title:** 
 HR Generalist
 



**Experience:** 
 2–3 years
 



**Location:** 
 Bengaluru
 



**Work Mode:** 
 Hybrid
 



**Reports to:** 
 Director, People Operations
 



**About the Role** 




 The HR Generalist sits within Ushur's global Operations team — finance, accounting, legal, revenue operations, enablement and HR. The role supports the People function globally, with most day\-to\-day focus on India operations, spanning payroll and statutory administration, benefits, the employee lifecycle, compliance, recruitment and engagement.
 



 You work directly with Operations colleagues in India and the US as a peer on one global team, with shared ownership of company\-wide processes.
 



 Alongside the operational core, the role carries the People function's automation work — identifying where AI can take on repetitive tasks across hiring, onboarding and reporting, and supporting new ways of working as they are adopted across the India team. Ushur is becoming an AI\-native company, and this is where that shows up in People processes.
 



 Operational accuracy comes first: payroll correct and filings on time. The Director, People Operations reviews work carrying statutory or financial risk, with independent ownership building through the first few cycles.
 



 Three things distinguish this role. You work across the whole India People function rather than a slice of it, at a point when most people are still administering parts of it. You work on a question few practitioners at any level get near: how AI is used responsibly in decisions about people, in a business built for regulated industries. And you sit in a global Operations function, not a local support desk.
 



**AI\-Native Operations** 




 Automation is core to the Operations team's mandate, and the standard is straightforward: where a process can be run by a workflow, it should be, and a person's time should go to the parts requiring judgment. Dedicated time is allocated to this, with access to Ushur's own platform. In practice, that means:
 


* Finding repetitive tasks in People processes and automating them.
* Using AI to help with screening, scheduling, checks and reporting — with a person always making the final call on anything that affects an individual.
* Helping new joiners get comfortable with these tools from the start.



**Responsibilities** 




**Payroll and statutory compliance** 



* Run the monthly India payroll cycle — inputs, validation, and post\-payroll reconciliation — working with Finance and Director, People Operations.
* Prepare termination pay inputs and full and final settlements, including notice, leave encashment and recovery calculations, for review before release.
* Support periodic salary structure and labour code updates led by the Director, People Operations.
* Support statutory compliance across PF, EPFO, NPS and professional tax, and act as the first point of contact for employee queries on tax regimes, declarations and payslips.
* Maintain accurate employee records, leave data and reporting in the HRIS.



**Benefits and vendor management** 



* Administer the India benefits programme, including group medical insurance, OPD, meal cards and wellness initiatives.
* Manage benefits vendors : onboarding and offboarding of employees, claims escalations, invoice processing with Finance, quarterly reviews and annual renewals.
* Gather market and cost data to support annual renewals and vendor evaluations.



**Employee lifecycle** 



* Run onboarding end\-to\-end: pre\-joining documentation, HRIS workflows, induction, systems and access coordination with IT, and 30\-60\-90 plans.
* Run offboarding end\-to\-end: exit formalities, relieving and experience letters, asset and access recovery, benefits removal, final settlement coordination, and exit conversations.
* Issue employment letters and respond to employment and background verification requests.
* Administer the HRIS and improve the workflows within it.



**Talent acquisition** 



* Conduct first\-level screening for candidates against structured rubrics and present evidence\-based recommendations.
* Coordinate interview loops across India and US time zones, and keep candidates informed throughout.
* Administer and improve the applicant tracking system, and maintain hiring data and reporting.



**Compliance, policy and documentation** 



* Provide administrative support to the POSH Internal Committee, including the statutory training cadence, record\-keeping and awareness communication.
* Maintain the India People folder set as the single source of truth for the function.
* Support internal and external audits by preparing documentation and responding to information requests.



**Employee experience and engagement** 



* Translate engagement survey findings into practical actions and track them through to closure.
* Run recognition programmes, milestone celebrations and engagement initiatives for the India office.
* Support all\-hands and internal communication for the India team.
* Partner with workplace and administration colleagues on office operations, and administer operational programmes such as the on\-call roster.



**Qualifications** 




**Essential** 



* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related field.
* 2–3 years' experience in Human Resources, with broad exposure across its core functions.
* Experience supporting an employee population of comparable size, approximately 100 to 200, preferably within a startup or scale\-up environment.
* Demonstrated experience running payroll inputs, onboarding, compliance administration and employee query resolution with limited supervision.
* Exposure to recruitment, including interview coordination, candidate communication and applicant tracking system use.
* Familiarity with and enthusiasm for using AI tools to improve efficiency.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to organise and interpret significant volumes of information accurately.
* Working knowledge of Indian employment law and payroll practices.



**Attributes** 



* Receptive to feedback and able to act on it promptly.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills across employees, candidates, leadership and external partners.
* Ownership\-minded, with a track record of taking tasks through to closure and escalating issues early.
* Adaptable and able to re\-prioritise at pace without compromising accuracy.
* Comfortable working with limited supervision, having run core HR processes directly rather than only in a support capacity.
* Interested in AI and automation, with practical use of AI tools to simplify repetitive work.



**Selection criteria** 



* Established use of AI tools in your daily work, with examples of what you have built. Informal work is fine; demonstrated application is required.
* A track record of identifying repetitive work and addressing it.
* The ability to explain the purpose of a process before proposing changes to it.
* A considered view on where AI should not be applied, and the reasoning behind it.



  





**Why Join Us?** 



* **Company culture.** 
 A values\-driven environment built on respect, inclusion, and collaboration.
* **Paid time off.** 
 Twenty days of flexible paid time off annually.
* **Health benefits.** 
 Preventive check\-ups, medical insurance for employees and dependents, wellness sessions, and health talks.
* **Compensation and equity.** 
 Competitive compensation and stock options — a direct stake in Ushur's success.
* **Professional development.** 
 Reimbursed certifications, plus the Ushur Community's learning resources.

title: Benefits & Wellness Manager
description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.
   

  

**Job Description**
 This role is responsible for delivering core benefit design \& planning initiatives to all plan participants by applying professional judgment, knowledge, experience and a broad perspective. The individual will be responsible for managing all aspects of retirement plans and programs including vendor management, compliance, project management, strategic planning and design and communication. In addition, the individual will be responsible for implementing, managing and developing innovative solutions that support the business unit strategy and design by applying thought leadership and their subject matter expertise.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The Manager – Benefits \& Wellness will be responsible for designing, administering, and continuously improving Allstate India's employee benefits programs and wellness initiatives. This is a strategic and operational role that requires deep expertise in Indian statutory benefits, market best practices, and holistic employee wellbeing frameworks. The incumbent will partner closely with HR Business Partners, Finance, Legal, and global Total Rewards teams to deliver a competitive, compliant, and employee\-centric benefits experience.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Benefits Program Design \& Administration**
* Own the end\-to\-end administration of all employee benefits including Group Health Insurance (GHI), Group Term Life (GTL), Group Personal Accident (GPA), and supplemental coverage plans.
* Lead annual benefits renewals — including vendor negotiations, RFP/RFQ processes, plan redesign, and cost benchmarking — to ensure market competitiveness and fiscal responsibility.
* Manage relationships with insurance brokers, TPAs (Third Party Administrators), and wellness vendors; monitor service delivery SLAs and resolve escalations.
* Ensure seamless enrolment processes for new joiners, life events (marriage, childbirth, etc.), and annual open enrolment windows.
* Maintain and update benefits documentation, employee\-facing communications, and FAQs on the HR portal.


**Statutory \& Regulatory Compliance**
* Ensure full compliance with Indian statutory benefits including Provident Fund (PF), Employee State Insurance (ESI), Gratuity, Maternity Benefit Act, and Professional Tax.
* Monitor regulatory changes from EPFO, ESIC, IRDAI, and other authorities; proactively update programs and communicate implications to leadership.
* Liaise with statutory consultants, auditors, and government bodies as required for filings, inspections, and assessments.
* Maintain accurate records for statutory audits and coordinate responses during compliance reviews.


**Employee Wellness Strategy**
* Develop and execute a comprehensive, multi\-dimensional employee wellness strategy encompassing physical, mental, financial, and social wellbeing.
* Curate and manage wellness vendor partnerships — including EAP (Employee Assistance Programs), telehealth platforms, fitness reimbursements, and mindfulness apps.
* Drive participation in wellness programs through effective communication campaigns, challenges, and manager enablement initiatives.
* Measure wellness program effectiveness using engagement metrics, utilisation data, and employee survey insights; report findings to HR leadership on a quarterly basis.
* Champion mental health awareness within the organisation; coordinate with EAP providers to ensure accessible and confidential support for employees.


**Data Analytics \& Reporting**
* Analyse benefits utilisation trends, claims data, and cost metrics to identify opportunities for plan optimisation and cost containment.
* Prepare regular dashboards and reports for HR leadership and Finance, covering benefits spend, renewal outcomes, vendor performance, and wellness engagement.
* Conduct benefits benchmarking surveys and competitive analyses to inform the annual Total Rewards strategy.
* Support HR Analytics team with data for compensation surveys (Aon, Mercer, Willis Towers Watson) covering benefits components.


**Employee Experience \& Communication**
* Design and deliver clear, engaging benefits communication materials — total rewards statements, onboarding guides, benefits booklets, and digital content.
* Conduct benefits orientation sessions for new hires and awareness sessions for the broader employee population.
* Serve as a subject matter expert and escalation point for employee benefits queries, ensuring prompt and accurate resolution.
* Collaborate with HRBPs to proactively address benefits\-related concerns raised during stay interviews, exit interviews, and pulse surveys.


**Stakeholder Collaboration \& Projects**
* Partner with the Global Total Rewards team to align India benefits with global philosophy, governance standards, and reporting requirements.
* Support M\&A, workforce expansion, and restructuring activities from a benefits due diligence and integration perspective.
* Lead or participate in cross\-functional HR projects related to Total Rewards, employee experience, and digital HR transformation.
* Manage a team of 1–2 Benefits Analysts; provide coaching, performance feedback, and development opportunities.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
**Education**
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Commerce, or a related field. MBA/PGDM in HR preferred.
* Certifications in Total Rewards (e.g., WorldatWork CEB, GRP) are a strong advantage.


**Experience**
* 14 years of progressive HR experience with a minimum of 5 years in a dedicated Benefits and/or Total Rewards function.
* Proven track record in managing large\-scale Group Health, Life, and Accident insurance programs in a multinational or technology\-driven organisation.
* Experience working with statutory compliance (PF, Gratuity, ESI, etc.) in India is mandatory.
* Prior experience in wellness program design and vendor management is strongly preferred.
* Exposure to global/regional Total Rewards governance in a shared services or GCC (Global Capability Centre) environment is an added advantage.


**Technical Skills**
* Strong proficiency in HRIS platforms (Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, or equivalent); experience with benefits modules preferred.
* Advanced Excel skills; familiarity with data visualisation tools (Power BI, Tableau) is a plus.
* Understanding of insurance products, actuarial concepts, and claims management processes.
* Working knowledge of Indian labour laws and statutory benefit regulations.


**Behavioural Competencies**
* Strategic Thinking: Ability to connect benefits strategy to broader business and talent objectives.
* Analytical Mindset: Data\-driven approach to decision\-making; comfortable with numbers, trends, and cost modelling.
* Stakeholder Management: Skilled at building relationships across levels — from front\-line employees to C\-suite leaders.
* Execution Excellence: Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to simplify complex benefits concepts for diverse audiences.
* Empathy \& Employee Focus: Genuine commitment to employee wellbeing and advocacy for a positive employee experience.


**What We Offer**
 At Allstate India, we believe our people are our greatest strength. We are committed to providing a workplace where every employee can thrive.
   

  

* Competitive compensation and a comprehensive Total Rewards package including performance bonuses and long\-term incentives.
* Industry\-leading health and wellness benefits for employees and their families.
* Generous paid leave programs including privilege leave, sick leave, maternity/paternity leave, and bereavement leave.
* Robust learning and development programs including access to global L\&D platforms and certification sponsorships.
* A diverse, inclusive, and respectful work culture grounded in Allstate's core values.
* Hybrid work model with flexibility to support work\-life integration.
* Employee assistance programs (EAP), mental health support, and wellness reimbursements.


**Equal Opportunity Statement**
 Allstate India Private Limited is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of gender, caste, religion, ethnicity, disability, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

One where you can shape the future of protection while supporting causes that mean the most to you. title: HR Operations Specialist I
description:
**Job Description**
**ABOUT THE ROLE**
 As an HR Operations Specialist, you will play a critical role in delivering high\-quality HR services across APAC and EMEA. You will be responsible for the end\-to\-end execution of employee lifecycle transactions, ensuring accurate HR data management, operational excellence, and a positive employee experience.
   

  

 Working within a global HR Operations team, you will serve as a trusted partner to employees, managers, HR Business Partners, and other stakeholders by providing expert support, resolving complex inquiries, and ensuring HR processes are delivered accurately, efficiently, and in compliance with local requirements.
   

  

 This role requires a proactive and detail\-oriented HR professional who thrives in a fast\-paced environment, takes ownership of their work, and continuously seeks opportunities to improve processes and service delivery.
   

  

**Job Duties**
* Execute end\-to\-end employee lifecycle transactions across APAC and EMEA, including hires, transfers, promotions, organizational changes, leave administration, and terminations.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for HR operational inquiries, providing timely and accurate support to employees, managers, and HR stakeholders.
* Maintain employee records and HR systems, ensuring the highest standards of data accuracy, integrity, and compliance.
* Independently manage HR transactions within Oracle and related systems, ensuring accurate and timely processing.
* Ensure HR processes are completed in accordance with established service level agreements and internal controls.
* Support onboarding and offboarding activities, including preparation of documentation, system updates, and stakeholder coordination.
* Partner closely with HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Benefits, and other teams to ensure seamless HR service delivery.
* Identify opportunities for process improvements and contribute to initiatives that enhance operational efficiency and employee experience.
* Support audits, reporting activities, data validation exercises, and compliance\-related requirements.
* Maintain and update process documentation, knowledge articles, and standard operating procedures.


**YOU MUST HAVE:** 
  

  

* 4\+ years of experience in HR Operations, HR Shared Services, HR Administration, or a similar HR support role.
* Strong knowledge of employee lifecycle processes and HR operations.
* Hands\-on experience processing HR transactions within an HRIS platform.
* Experience supporting employees and stakeholders across multiple countries or regions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality and accuracy.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and meet deadlines in a dynamic environment.


**WE VALUE**
* Experience working within a global HR Operations or Shared Services environment supporting APAC and/or EMEA.

* Experience supporting employee benefits administration in India, including coordination of benefits programs, vendor interactions, and employee inquiries.
* Exposure to HR process improvement initiatives, system implementations, or project work.
* Understanding of HR compliance and employment documentation requirements.
* Strong customer\-service orientation and commitment to delivering an exceptional employee experience.
* Ability to build trusted relationships with employees, managers, and HR stakeholders.
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a global and multicultural environment.
* Continuous improvement mindset with a focus on efficiency and operational excellence.

title: Specialist, HR Compliance
description:
**Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Corporate**
 We’re a global, multi\-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Corporate, you are integral to our company’s award\-winning success.
   

  

* Enrich your managerial and organizational talents – from finance, quality, and supply chain to human resources, IT, sales, and strategy
* Augment your comprehensive skillset with expert training across decision\-making, change management, leadership, and business development
* Obtain 360\-degree support throughout your career life cycle, from early\-stage to seasoned leader


**About The Role**
 A Payroll Specialist\&Compliance is responsible for supporting the end‑to‑end payroll process for the assigned country, ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant payroll delivery for internal clients. The role includes managing all payroll‑related activities, executing regular payroll cycles, administering employee benefits, along with a strong understanding of local regulations is essential, and candidates should be able to propose adjustments to ensure alignment with state and federal laws.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of Indian labor laws and applicable state and federal employment regulations.
* Review and evaluate company policies to ensure compliance, recommending changes to meet legal requirements.
* Ensure records are maintained in line with local regulations and data privacy standards.
* Assist with internal and external audits, including those conducted by clients and labor authorities
* Coordinate with the payroll vendor and finance team each month to finalize payroll timelines, ensuring timely execution and minimizing errors for a smooth payroll process.
* Ensure payroll inputs are accurately consolidated from all data sources—including emails, payroll portals, Workday, and payroll partners—and validate these inputs in alignment with payroll policies and defined processes.
* Respond to complex queries and escalations received from employees, HR, authorities, or other departments
* Responsible for executing monthly and ad‑hoc payroll control reports related to benefits‑in‑kind to ensure tax and payroll compliance.
* Create and maintain internal documentation for audit.
* Execute internal monthly payroll control reports and investigate payroll issues using problem solving technics
* Initiate process improvements and bring new ideas to increase efficiency and quality of provided service
* Responds to payroll queries from the finance team and manages finance‑related payroll audits.


**What You Need**
* University or College degree, preferably in Business Administration
* Minimum 1\-3 Years of experience in India Payroll and Compliance role or related field.
* Should have handle employee grievances related to social security matters (PF) and collaborate with Rewards and Procurement to ensure compliance with wage and employment regulations for both direct and third\-party employees.
* Maintains strong working knowledge of labor laws, best practices, and current trends and developments in the field.
* India payroll processing experience and Time management experience
* Proficiency in English communication
* Proficient level knowledge of Microsoft Office programs, especially Excel
* Workday knowledge
* Showing ability to work with confidential information
* Being able to work with priorities and deadlines
* Project management experience
* Basic Payroll accounting knowledge


**Bonus Points if You Have**
* Master’s or University/College degree in HR/Payroll field
* APAC payroll experience
* Maintain records in accordance with local regulations and data privacy policies.
* Support internal and external audits, including those by clients and labor authorities.
* Experience with Shared Service Center environment
* Service Now knowledge (ticketing system)
* Employee Customer Service experience


**What Makes You Eligible**
* Be willing to work from Bangalore office
* Full\-time employment
* Be willing to travel max 10%


**What We Offer**
* Access to employee discounts on world\-class products (JBL, HARMAN Kardon, AKG, and more)
* Extensive training opportunities through our own HARMAN University
* Competitive wellness benefits
* “Be Brilliant” employee recognition and rewards program.
* An inclusive and diverse work environment that fosters and encourages professional and personal development


**You Belong Here**
 HARMAN is committed to making every employee feel welcomed, valued, and empowered. No matter what role you play, we encourage you to share your ideas, voice your distinct perspective, and bring your whole self with you – all within a support\-minded culture that celebrates what makes each of us unique. We also recognize that learning is a lifelong pursuit and want you to flourish. We proudly offer added opportunities for training, development, and continuing education, further empowering you to live the career you want.
   

  

**About HARMAN: Where Innovation Unleashes Next\-Level Technology**
 Ever since the 1920s, we’ve been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected.
   

  

 Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. Our renowned automotive and lifestyle solutions can be found everywhere, from the music we play in our cars and homes to venues that feature today’s most sought\-after performers, while our digital transformation solutions serve humanity by addressing the world’s ever\-evolving needs and demands. Marketing our award\-winning portfolio under 16 iconic brands, such as JBL, Mark Levinson, and Revel, we set ourselves apart by exceeding the highest engineering and design standards for our customers, our partners and each other.
   

  

 If you’re ready to innovate and do work that makes a lasting impact, join our talent community today!

 Please be aware that HARMAN recruiters will always communicate with you from an '@harman.com', ‘@careers.harman.com’ or ‘harmanglobal.avature.net’ email address. PhonePe also processes over 33 Crore (330\+ Million) transactions daily with an Annualized Total Payment Value (TPV) of over INR 150 lakh crore.
   

  

 PhonePe’s portfolio of businesses includes the distribution of financial products (Insurance, Lending, and Wealth) as well as new consumer tech businesses (Pincode \- hyperlocal e\-commerce and Indus AppStore Localized App Store for the Android ecosystem) in India, which are aligned with the company’s vision to offer every Indian an equal opportunity to accelerate their progress by unlocking the flow of money and access to services.

title: Senior HRBP
description:
Back to jobs
   

  

 Senior HRBP
   

  

 Bangalore, India
   

  

****About Ethos****
 Ethos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three\-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.
   

  

****About The Role****
 As an HR Business Partner for India, you'll work closely with the Director of People – APAC to support our Bangalore based teams through a period of rapid growth. You will enable leaders to achieve their business goals through their people \- building the capacity of the organization to attract, develop, and retain talent while ensuring every decision holds up against India's statutory and regulatory framework.
   

  

 This role combines strategic HRBP partnership with hands\-on ownership of India\-specific compliance, employee relations, and operational rigor. You'll be a trusted advisor to business leaders and a steady, empathetic presence for employees, while working closely with Payroll \& Compliance, Talent Acquisition, and Total Rewards to deliver a consistent employee experience.
   

  

****Duties And Responsibilities:****
 Business Partnership
   

  

* Conduct regular cadence meetings with your assigned business unit(s), acting as the primary People point of contact for leaders and employees.
* Provide compensation and leveling guidance to business unit leaders, in partnership with Total Rewards, anchored to India market benchmarks and internal equity.
* Analyze workforce trends and metrics \- attrition, hiring, promotions, engagement \- in partnership with the People Operations team to develop solutions, programs, and policies.
* Drive business unit organizational design and talent strategy to achieve business objectives, including headcount planning and role scoping.


 Employee Relations \& Compliance
   

  

* Manage and resolve complex employee relations issues; conduct thorough, objective, and well\-documented investigations.
* Maintain in\-depth, current knowledge of Indian labor law \- including the Shops and Establishments Act, Payment of Bonus Act, Payment of Gratuity Act, POSH Act, and the New Labour Codes as they come into force \- to reduce legal risk and ensure regulatory compliance across Karnataka and any other state of operation.
* Partner with Payroll \& HR Compliance and external legal counsel as needed on statutory matters, notices, and filings.
* Own or contribute to background verification (BGV) exception handling and RAG\-based risk assessment for your business unit, in line with company policy.
* Provide day\-to\-day performance management guidance to managers \- coaching, counseling, career development, and disciplinary action \- consistent with Indian employment norms and documentation standards.
* Work closely with management and employees to improve working relationships, build morale, and increase productivity and retention.
* Provide HR policy guidance and interpretation, flagging gaps between global policy and India\-specific legal requirements.


 Talent, Training \& Culture
   

  

* Identify training needs for business units and individual coaching needs for people managers; monitor and follow up on training and upskilling objectives.
* Support onboarding and offboarding processes for your business unit, partnering with Onboarding \& Ops on a smooth, compliant employee lifecycle.
* Gather and report on metrics related to retention, promotion, hiring, and diversity for your client group.
* Help build and refine India People Ops systems and processes \- you'll help write a policy when one doesn't yet exist.


****Qualifications And Skills:****
* 8\+ years of experience as an HRBP, with a strong point of view on how HRBPs move a business forward; experience at a fast\-growing technology or insurance company is a plus.
* In\-depth working knowledge of Indian labor law and statutory compliance \- PF, ESI, gratuity, statutory bonus, Karnataka Shops \& Establishments Act, and the New Labour Codes. Prior exposure to a multi\-state India compliance footprint is a strong plus.
* Experience managing complex employee relations cases, including conducting investigations and resolving disputes; experience partnering with Underwriting, Engineering, or another regulated business function is a plus.
* Working knowledge of multiple HR disciplines \- organizational design, learning and development, compensation, HR technology, and data management.
* Exposure to a matrixed or multi\-country People team structure (e.g., partnering across India, Singapore, or the US) is a plus.
* You are an empathetic listener who can build trust quickly and hold it, even in difficult conversations.
* You are data\-driven \- able to back up your recommendations to client groups with solid data and clear reasoning.
* You thrive in a fast\-paced, first\-principles environment and see the ambiguity of a scaling company as an exciting challenge rather than a blocker.
* You are a strong communicator, comfortable representing the People function to senior stakeholders.
* You have a genuine passion for diversity, equity, and inclusion.
* Bachelor's degree required; a postgraduate qualification in HR or a related field is preferred.


 Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At Ethos we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.  Business Partnership

title: Consultant
description:
**About NewSpace Research \& Technologies (NRT)**
 NewSpace Research \& Technologies (NRT) is India’s leading Aerospace \& Defence innovation company developing next\-generation autonomous systems, AI\-driven aerial platforms, and advanced technologies for defence and dual\-use applications.
   

  

 Our teams work at the intersection of engineering, product development, and manufacturing, solving complex real\-world problems with speed, precision, and purpose. Our portfolio includes intelligent uncrewed systems such as Autonomous Swarming Drones, Collaborative Combat Aerial Vehicles (CCAV), Tethered Platforms, High\-Altitude Pseudo Satellites (HAPS), Loitering Munitions, and many more.
   

  

 With 500\+ engineers across R\&D and manufacturing, we collaborate with leading Indian and global Defence \& Aerospace organizations to build the future of autonomous systems.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We’re looking for a hands\-on, strategic HR Business Partner to work closely with leaders across engineering, product, and manufacturing functions — the teams shaping India’s next generation of aerospace and technology systems.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a high\-performance, high\-velocity environment, understands technology and manufacturing cultures, and can translate business goals into people strategies. You’ll partner with leaders to shape the organization’s capability, drive performance, ensure compliance, and enhance the overall employee experience — while staying deeply grounded in day\-to\-day HR execution.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Strategic Business Partnering
* Partner with functional heads to align people priorities with business objectives, ensuring workforce readiness and capability for upcoming projects.
* Drive organization design, manpower planning, and succession strategies aligned to growth.
* Use HR analytics and insights to support data\-driven decision\-making around talent and engagement.
* Act as a trusted advisor to leaders on talent performance, structure, and employee relations.
* Talent \& Capability Development
* Work closely with the TA function to ensure timely onboarding of the right talent for each function.
* Own the onboarding and assimilation experience, ensuring new hires have clear 90\-day plans and connect well with their teams.
* Identify key skill gaps and coordinate with L\&D to design upskilling, reskilling, and leadership development interventions.
* Support career progression and internal mobility frameworks.
* Performance \& Rewards
* Lead the performance management cycle – goal setting, continuous feedback, appraisal discussions, and performance improvement plans.
* Partner with the compensation team to drive salary reviews, benchmarking, and rewards programs.
* Support the implementation of variable pay, incentive, and recognition frameworks.
* Ensure internal equity and consistency in compensation and progression decisions.
* Employee Relations \& Engagement
* Foster a culture of openness, inclusion, and performance accountability.
* Lead employee engagement and communication initiatives that enhance morale and retention across sites.
* Manage grievances, employee relations cases, and workplace conflict with fairness and discretion.
* Conduct skip\-level connects, stay interviews, and feedback sessions to identify engagement drivers.
* HR Operations, Payroll \& Compliance
* Partner with HR Operations to ensure timely and accurate payroll inputs, employee records, and documentation.
* Ensure smooth handling of HRIS, attendance, and compliance activities across employment categories (permanent, contract, consultants).
* Work closely with Finance for payroll audits, budget validation, and manpower cost controls.
* Oversee policy implementation, discipline cases, and ensure adherence to all applicable labour laws and new codes.
* Administrative \& Site HR Responsibilities
* Manage on\-ground administrative HR tasks — employee data updates, vendor HR coordination, and HR\-related communication for the BU/site.
* Ensure all HR activities at the business unit or facility level run smoothly — from attendance tracking to compliance checks.
* Support logistics for employee onboarding, travel reimbursements, events, and welfare programs.


**Skills \& Attributes**
* Strong business acumen and understanding of engineering/manufacturing environments.
* Proven ability to balance strategic influence and operational execution.
* Experience driving performance, rewards, and engagement frameworks in a fast\-paced tech setup.
* High ownership, agility, and comfort in managing multiple priorities.
* Excellent interpersonal, analytical, and communication skills.
* Proficiency with HRMS tools, payroll systems, spreadsheets, and HR analytics dashboards.
* Fluency in English; working knowledge of Kannada and/or Hindi is an advantage.


**Experience \& Qualification**
* Master’s degree in Human Resources or Business Management (Engineering background preferred).
* 10–12 years of total HR experience, with a minimum of 8 years in an HRBP role supporting technology, product, or manufacturing functions.
* Experience in deep\-tech, aerospace, or advanced manufacturing organizations is a strong plus.

 People Operations strives to revolutionize human resources the same way that Google has revolutionized search. You will focus on employee experiences, provide responses, share knowledge and experiences with team members, and balance needs with philosophy, principles, and available resources.

title: Cluster Factory HR Manager
description:
About the Company
 



  





 Aditya Birla Lifestyle Brands Limited (ABLBL), a part of the Aditya Birla Group, is a leading branded apparel company with a comprehensive portfolio of marquee lifestyle brands.
 



 As of March 31, 2025, the Company operates a retail footprint of over 4\.6 million sq. ft., comprising 3,253 exclusive brand outlets, presence across 38,000\+ multi\-brand outlets, and over 7,000 shop\-in\-shops in department stores across the country.
 



 The Company’s brand portfolio includes India’s most established and trusted names – Louis Philippe, Van Heusen, Allen Solly, and Peter England – each with a legacy of over 25 years.
 



 These brands have consistently delivered sustained growth, driven by a sharp focus on design\-led innovation, category expansion, and operational excellence across product lines spanning formal, casual, and occasion wear.
 



 ABLBL has built a strong presence in the innerwear and athleisure market through Van Heusen Innerwear, which has rapidly scaled its distribution network across India. The Company’s portfolio is further enhanced through strategic partnerships with leading international brands including Simon Carter, American Eagle and Reebok. American Eagle has emerged as one of India’s most preferred premium denim brands, while Reebok – transitioned under the Company’s management in 2022 – has expanded its footprint across multiple channels. Simon Carter continues to strengthen its position in the premium menswear segment through its distinctive design language and curated collections.
 



  





**About the Job Role** 




 The Cluster Factory HR will be responsible for leading and managing the Human Resources function across a cluster of 4\-6 manufacturing units. The role requires strong expertise in Industrial Relations (IR), statutory compliance, labor laws, workforce management, employee engagement, and HR operations to ensure seamless factory operations and a positive employee relations climate.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\.Industrial Relations \& Employee Relations** 



* Drive harmonious industrial relations across all assigned manufacturing units.
* Manage union interactions, wage negotiations, settlements, and grievance handling.
* Support plant leadership in maintaining a positive employee relations environment.
* Handle disciplinary matters, domestic inquiries, and dispute resolution.
* Ensure proactive mitigation of IR risks and compliance with labor regulations.



**2\.Statutory Compliance \& Legal Governance** 



* Ensure 100% compliance with applicable labor laws and statutory requirements.
* Monitor compliance related to Factories Act, Industrial Relations Code, Social Security Code, Contract Labour regulations, Shops \& Establishment Act, and other applicable legislations.
* Coordinate statutory audits and inspections from government authorities.

title: Lead Training Manager
description:
**Lead Training Manager \| Urban Company** 




  





**About the Company**




 Urban Company is a technology platform offering customers a variety of services at home. Customers use our platform to book services such as beauty treatments, haircuts, massage therapy, cleaning, plumbing, carpentry, appliance repair, painting, etc., all delivered in the comfort of their home and at a time of their choosing. We promise our customers a high\-quality, standardized, and reliable service experience. To fulfill this promise, we work closely with our hand\-picked service partners, enabling them with technology, training, products, tools, financing, insurance, and brand, helping them succeed and deliver on this promise.
 



 Urban Company started as UrbanClap in November 2014, when its founders, Abhiraj, Raghav, and Varun, realized that the home services industry was predominantly unorganized, fragmented, and offline. Customers found it challenging to avail quality services conveniently, and service professionals were struggling to make ends meet, having to rely upon several
 



 middlemen, contractors, and local aggregators. The founders felt that the industry was ripe for disruption, and launched Urban Company, with three key principles in mind \-
 


1. **Customer love:** 
 Build a platform that offers truly delightful and differentiated services
2. **Partner empowerment:** 
 Build a deep, full\-stack partnership with service partners, helping improve their earnings and overall livelihood
3. **Technology first:** 
 Bring innovation and technology to an age\-old industry



  





**Job Description:** 




 We are seeking an experienced Lead Training Manager for our Cleaning Category to join our dynamic team. The LTM will play a crucial role in ensuring the high\-quality delivery of home cleaning services in our designated cities. This individual will be responsible for leading all training initiatives, developing and refining training content, and providing technical (relating to home cleaning services) and behavioral training to our partners to guarantee a delightful customer experience.
 



  





**What You’ll Do:** 



* Lead and manage all training programs for professionals offering home cleaning services in the allotted city.
* Develop and refine training content, ensuring it aligns with industry standards and best practices.
* Provide hands\-on training and support to professional partners on standard operating procedures (SOPs) to ensure the delivery of high\-quality services.
* Implement strategies to improve service quality through training interventions.
* Lead, coach, and provide guidance to 10\-12 city\-level trainers, ensuring capability building and performance excellence.
* Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of training programs, making necessary adjustments to meet evolving business needs.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to identify training needs and develop targeted solutions to address gaps.
* Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in training and development for blue\-collar workers.



  





**What We Need:** 



* Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in Logistics, Internet, FMCG, QSR or other Startups, with a focus on training and development of Blue/Grey Collar workforce.
* Proven experience in managing teams of trainers/professionals, preferably in hotels or facilities management.
* Demonstrated expertise in developing and delivering training content for blue\-collar workers.
* Passion for delivering exceptional customer experiences and driving continuous improvement.



  





 At Urban Company we are committed to providing equal and fair opportunities in employment and creating an inclusive work environment. We endeavour to maintain a work environment free from harassment based on age, colour, physical ability, marital status, parental status, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation, or gender identity.

title: Director, Workforce Management
description:
**About HireRight**
 HireRight is the premier global background screening and workforce solutions provider. We bring clarity and confidence to vetting and hiring decisions through integrated, tailored solutions, driving a higher standard of accuracy in everything we do. Combining in\-house talent, personalized services, and proprietary technology, we ensure the best candidate experience possible. PBSA accredited and based in Nashville, TN, we offer expertise from our regional centers across 200 countries and territories in The Americas, Europe, Asia, and the Middle East. Our commitment to get it right every time, everywhere, makes us the trusted partner of businesses and organizations worldwide.
   

  

**Overview**
 The Director of Workforce Management (WFM) is responsible for leading the organization's workforce planning strategy and execution across forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling, and real\-time performance management. This role ensures the right resources are available at the right time to meet business demand, service level commitments, productivity targets, and employee experience objectives.
   

  

 The Director will lead a team of workforce management professionals and leverage advanced analytics, workforce technologies, and operational insights to optimize staffing investments while improving customer and employee outcomes. The role serves as a strategic business partner to operational leaders, finance, HR, and executive stakeholders.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Workforce Forecasting \& Demand Planning**
* Develop and lead enterprise workforce forecasting strategies across short\-, medium\-, and long\-term planning horizons.
* Create accurate volume, workload, and staffing forecasts using historical data, business drivers, growth projections, and predictive analytics.
* Partner with Operations, Finance, and Business Leadership to align workforce plans with strategic objectives and budget requirements.
* Monitor forecast accuracy and implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance planning processes.
* Conduct scenario modeling and sensitivity analysis to support business decisions, organizational changes, and growth strategies.


**Workforce Forecasting \& Demand Planning**
* Develop and lead enterprise workforce forecasting strategies across short\-, medium\-, and long\-term planning horizons.
* Create accurate volume, workload, and staffing forecasts using historical data, business drivers, growth projections, and predictive analytics.
* Partner with Operations, Finance, and Business Leadership to align workforce plans with strategic objectives and budget requirements.
* Monitor forecast accuracy and implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance planning processes.
* Conduct scenario modeling and sensitivity analysis to support business decisions, organizational changes, and growth strategies.


**Capacity \& Staff Planning**
* Establish workforce capacity models to determine staffing requirements and resource allocation strategies.
* Lead annual, quarterly, monthly and weekly workforce planning cycles.
* Develop hiring plans and staffing recommendations based on forecasted demand, attrition trends, productivity assumptions, and business requirements.
* Collaborate with Talent Acquisition and HR to align recruitment strategies with workforce needs.
* Evaluate operational efficiency opportunities and recommend workforce optimization strategies.


**Scheduling \& Workforce Optimization**
* Oversee development and execution of workforce schedules that balance service delivery goals, productivity targets, and employee preferences.
* Ensure compliance with labor laws, company policies, and contractual obligations.
* Drive scheduling best practices, flexible staffing models, shift optimization, and workforce utilization strategies.
* Evaluate and implement scheduling technologies and automation opportunities.
* Lead initiatives to improve schedule adherence, occupancy, and workforce utilization.


**Real\-Time Management \& Analytics**
* Direct real\-time workforce operations to ensure service levels, response times, productivity, and operational KPIs are achieved.
* Monitor intraday performance and lead decision\-making related to staffing adjustments and contingency planning.
* Establish real\-time analytics capabilities, dashboards, and reporting frameworks.
* Identify trends, risks, and opportunities through operational data analysis.
* Provide actionable insights and recommendations to senior leadership.


**Leadership \& Team Development**
* Build, lead, and develop a high\-performing Workforce Management organization.
* Establish clear goals, performance metrics, and development plans for team members.
* Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, innovation, and customer focus.
* Mentor workforce planning leaders and create succession planning strategies within the WFM function.


**Strategic Partnership \& Governance**
* Serve as the subject matter expert for workforce management across the organization.
* Present workforce strategies, capacity plans, risks, and recommendations to executive leadership.
* Partner with Finance on budgeting, labor cost management, and productivity planning.
* Lead workforce management governance processes, performance reviews, and operational business reviews.
* Drive adoption of workforce management technologies and advanced analytics capabilities.


**Qualifications**
**Education**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations Management, Finance, Statistics, Industrial Engineering, Human Resources, or related field required.
* Master's degree preferred.


**Experience**
* 10\+ years of progressive workforce management, operations planning, or resource planning experience.
* 5\+ years of leadership experience managing forecasting, staffing, scheduling, and real\-time analytics teams.
* Experience in contact center, shared services, BPO, healthcare operations, retail operations, or other large\-scale workforce environments preferred.
* Demonstrated success leading workforce transformation and optimization initiatives.


**Technical Skills**
* Expertise in workforce management systems (Verint, NICE, Genesys, Calabrio, Aspect, UKG, or similar).
* Strong forecasting and statistical modeling skills.
* Advanced proficiency in workforce analytics, KPI reporting, and dashboard development.
* Experience with business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
* Strong Excel and data analysis capabilities.
* Familiarity with AI\-enabled forecasting and workforce optimization technologies preferred.


**What Do We Offer**
**HireRight does not accept unsolicited resumes through or from search firms or staffing agencies. All unsolicited resumes will be considered the property of HireRight and HireRight will not be obligated to pay a placement fee.**

title: Associate, Founder's Office
description:
***PLEASE ENSURE THAT YOU READ THE JD BEFORE APPLYING.***




  





**Background** 




 Mezink is a fast\-growing startup helping brands leverage the distribution of creators across social media. We have a bold vision to reimagine the relationship between creators and brands, using data and AI.
 



  





 We are headquartered in Singapore and have operations in more than 10 countries across Asia. You'll end up working on global projects from Day 1 along with a team based in atleast 15 different cities.
 



  





**Job Description** 




 The ideal candidate will work closely with the founders, gaining a front\-row seat to the entire business and contributing to various initiatives and projects across different departments, including sales, operations, growth, and more. This role requires someone who is very comfortable handling multiple things at the same time. There is likely to be frequent weekend work. The job description will change frequently and you'll be expected to learn things very quickly. The intensity will be high and the hours will be long but we can promise an insane learning curve and massive opportunities for growth. This role will not be easy. If you prioritise work\-life balance or are looking for a 9 to 5, this isn't the role for you.
 



  





 We are looking for hustlers who are willing to think out of the box and get stuff done \- without making excuses. If you are looking for a more structured set up to learn \- then this isn't the place. We are focussed on execution \- not coaching. Also, this role requires you to operate from Mezink's office in Bengaluru \- there is no remote option.
 



  





*While compensation is not a constraint for the right candidate, but, if you are looking to optimise cash compensation or are expecting hikes for simply switching,*
***please do not apply***
*.*




  





*If you already have an offer from somewhere and are only shopping around for higher compensation,*
***please do not apply***
*.*




  





*Like most early stage start\-ups, the compensation will be a combination of fixed cash, performance linked bonuses and meaningful equity. Do note that this is*
***NOT A PRODUCT ROLE.***




  





*We are only looking for people who are driven by the desire to learn and to build something spectacular.* 




  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




  





 There are really no qualifications for this role \- all we need are people who are smart, diligent and willing to put in the work. We are looking to hire learning machines who can grow along with the organization. We will offer enough opportunities to learn and grow quickly.
 



  





 But the following list of qualifications is generally useful:
 


* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Finance, Economics from a Tier 1 institution
* 1\-2\+ years of relevant experience working in a management/strategy/consulting or in a fast\-paced startup
* Very strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with clients and team\-members across geographies and cultures
* Willingness to get your hands dirty to solve problems quickly \- we are not looking for managers
* Extreme levels of ownership \- if something needs to be done, you can get it done no matter what



  





 We are always excited to have people who love building products from scratch and are self\-starters, hustlers and curious to learn. If you are passionate about working in a high\-paced startup, with amazing learning, empowerment, and growth potential, we would love to hear from you!
